Was amazing...the water is blue and green..the sand is like powder. ..water is warm with waves and near the Taj the cove for swimming was like a pool...the beach area is clean...thoroughly enjoyed it...
I haven't seen a lot of beaches in my life but I found this beach to be absolutely wonderful. It's clean. It's beautiful. I loved it.
Average beach unless you're in a nice resort. Much better beaches whiter sand and quieter down south of Sri Lanka.
Really beautiful long Beach with blue ocean and perfect views. We have been 4 days at Bentota and all 3 days were at this beach. A lot of water sports could help to discover the ocean.
The crashing waves from the Indian Ocean create an endlessly changing pattern of natural beauty for both the ears and the eyes.
Warm water, nice and small waves, big sandy beach, not crowded and paradisaical views - perfect beach for families and couples.

We went to Bentota Beach after spending 3 days at Unawatuna.  We wished we stayed at Bentota longer b/c the beach was much better for swimming with kids.  The waves are smaller and the sand is super soft and fine with no sea shells or coral or rocks.  It just squishes between your toes and the kids can build nice sand castles with the sand texture.  Only bad thing is there's no restaurants or cafes dotting the beach so bring your own snacks and drinks and hope you don't have to use the bathroom.
After being to Goa and Kerala I fail to see what the attraction is in Bentota. Narrow beach with limited food or seating options unless you are at one of the resorts

What I liked the most of Bentota beach was how quite and uncrowded it was. Its a perfect spot for relaxation away from all the crowded beaches like the ones I visited in other countries like Cyprus It has a nice golden sands and the beach is covered by a long like of green trees that gives it a very nice look and feel.

The bentota beach is very good. Very neat and clean. The beach has public shower also. Waves not very high so you can spend lot of time in sea. Very very beautiful view of sea. Very calm place and can spend good time at beach. Best property is taj and cinnamon as both on beach  .Both superb view and great property. Loft is good bar on beach.

The beach at Bentota and Ahungulla is very clean. Long stretch without too many people. Suitable for long walks. However, when we were there, it had Red flags all over due to choppy waters. Hence, could not swim or snorkel.
Fantastic Hotel Catering to travelers seeking various needs and wants - Value for your Money, a must stay.
One of the cleanest beach ever seen. Our hotel Vivanta by Taj had its own beach. We enjoyed the sea activity very much.
beach very clean with plenty of watersports for everyone,you do get charged for sunbeds though. good walks but sea is strong
The public area was decent. Not a big fan of the litter but overall nice beach. Lots of people!!!!!!

The beach area where we were staying was very clean. However, the tides are not great for swimming in, and the red flag was up constantly during our stay. It is fine to stroll along, and we were not hassled by beach traders. There are a number of stray dogs on the beach but they seemed fine, and well socialised to humans. There are no beds on the beach to rent or lay on and most people we saw used towels to lay on which seemed fine.
Very pretty, fairly quiet beach but the sea is too rough to swim and there are a few stray dogs knocking about at night.

We didn't stay in the main area of Bentota Beach we stayed 2km further down. We were slightly further from the convenience of town but the beach made it worth it! The beach was beautiful white soft sand crystal clear water with maybe 15 other people in sight all day. The sea was a little rough but I think this is the case throughout Sri Lanka. Follow our journey on Instagram @twolostllamas

We came here after from Hikkaduwa and were quite surprised at how quiet the beach was. No restaurants, no bars, just few sundbeds here and there. If you are looking for a quiet and very long beach to relax on your own, this is for you.
Nice sand, quite beach, suitable for relaxing vacations. We enjoyed our holidays on December. Highly recommended.

The beach is clean. Vast areas of beach and plenty of room for everyone. The sea is not rough and can walk deep into the ocean with water only coming upto the waist. However please check flags if seas are rough.
Nice People! Big waves, Refreshing visit. best to access in luxury hotels of bentota. You can also get a sun bed for a fee.

Stretching across 7-8 kms, the beach is tranquil, calm and clean. Filled with resorts, and hence free from all the noise and hustle bustle that spoils most beaches, this beach is perfect for the sunrise and sunset.
Just great simple beach at its best no beds umbrellas or sellers just pure beach we love it the walk along the beach goes to the lake and a temple good exercise too so enjoy

This beach has calm waters , soft sand and one can walk into the sea till far. The water clarity is not as good as she other beaches because the sand is very fine but it is great to swim and bathe in. The beach is also large with a big sand area that has not been encroached upon by shacks, unlike hikaduwa. A significant downside although is that there are no food or drink options on the beach except the big hotels that are on the beach front. So one must carry the food / drink they need. Great to be on with family and a safe option.
it was just amazing nothing else to say. a place where transportation is not an issue and a place where u can relax and enjoy the moment
Swim at own risk here, no life guards and very strong currents. Most people stay close to shore and it is advised not to wade in more than waist deep.

We were staying at Vivanta by Taj hotel which our hotel was steps away from our hotel. Beautiful beach , has waves was quite clean . I walked up and down this beach everyday in the afternoon as it was so pretty . We loved seeing the sunset it's was just amazingly beautiful . If ur staying in bentota it's a must to go see this beach .
Beautiful beach with miles of white sand! The sea can be a little rough but once your in and jumping the waves it's amazing! Worth a visit!

Great beach warm water and water activities Clean beach with beautiful soft sand Go see Putha in front of Bentota hotel he will look after you with Tuk Tuk, car etc as well as being a tour guide Good helpful guy
Beach is located 75m from main road.it is a calm place surrounded by 5star resorts.u can take a stroll. there are plenty of bars and pubs. A wine store is located in the main road.
Lovely beach. Not the safest bathing. Worth a walk to the jungle topped promontory. Never felt harassed or unsafe. Quiet without being unsocial. Separated from the town by a river, so quite private.
A super beautiful beach, with no crowds. The only downside it it's lacking budjet restaurants. So if you're looking for backpackers there's none, but you'll have the beach almost to your self.

Very tranquil but be prepared to be hounded by dodgy looking men for taxi services or a drink down a nearby hut. From discussion with the locals, these people are referred to as the 'beach boys'. Some honestly try to make ends meat whereas others may have bad intentions. I didn't find them violent (locals confirmed they rarely are), just very invasive.

The beach is great but there are very few good places to eat. We found Trax Garden restaurant, Malli's and Pier 88 within walking distance. There are no bars or cafe's, except for Pier 88 and unless you want to spend money on watersports then there is little else to do. There are always tuk-tuks to take you further a field.  Although the town is busy during the day and you need to have eyes in the back of your head to make sure you don't get run over, it becomes very quiet on a night time but always felt safe.
Bentota beach is amazing clean beach with golden sand. Nice and huge waves in the ocean. Stunning sunset from the beach.

One of the best beaches in this part of the world - sandy white beaches. shallow waters are also great without any rocks. value for money water sports. I tried, for the first time, water skiing and surfing. I managed to get a hand of it my age (44yr) and weight (76kg) thanks to good local tutors (who spoke basic English) recommended for individuals as well as family.
Very nice beach. It is very long and probably 40-50 meters wide. Overall it was clean. In the evening when we were walking it was full of small crabs.
We walked this beach every morning for a week and we saw the local fishermen and their catches, friendly dogs, stranded fish and nice waves
A great beach, clean and with a warm sea water! Great nature envolvment Those two I stayed are almost only for me and my wife...
long sandy beach, which is empty most of the time and faces the west for a lovely sun set. a must if you visit this part of Sri lanka

We spent a few hours early in the morning - we walked down from Centara Hotel. There was a small islet with a man-man structure about a few kilometres from the shore. That gave the sea a nice break ! It was lovely to see a bird on the edge of the waves looking for food.

A lovely beach fronting the seaside town of Bentota. Behind the beach are a series of mainly upscale hotels with bars and restaurants open to non residents. Behind the hotels is the Bentota river taking a leisurely route to the sea. Great for swimming and surfing but keep an eye on the warning flags when the tides are dangerous. Go to the elevated 'loft' bar for a good view of the sunset. Nice to people watch tourists and locals alike on weekend evenings.

clean beach, not many tourist when i was there.  The sea was really warm, waves high, idea for wave jumping, however sometimes the red flag was out and i did not see a life guard.   The usual sellers, selling sarongs, it was quite easy to get the price down .  Only downside, there were no beds to lie on, only sand

Bentota beach is the type of beach that you see in photos of faraway places. About 3 kms of beach that has only a few people on it. The sand at is soft and clean and the waves have proper white froth on them.  It was not good for swimming when we were there in November but the sea was not too cold and  was great to paddle and splosh about in.
Lovely long sandy beach with some good bars along and with few people so very peaceful You can walk all the way along from the hotel into town without any problem

Lovely beach and pure bliss. The sea is normally good to swim . When we visited,it was on red flag as there were strong currents but we went for lovely long walks and dipped out feet all the way. Not many vendors to bother you and the few who are there, would normally stop bothering if you're not interested.

The part of the beach were we stayed (south of city) is free from the bigger hotels close to town. Swimmimg is nicer here compared to a lot of other beaches, the waves are smaller and not so strong, and not so deep. Clean and quiet beach!

We stayed in a hotel right on this beach. It's beautiful golden sands and sunset are to die for. We haven't been in the sea as it looks very rough and my son is only 2. Other than choppy waters it's a beautiful clean beach

While the beach looks pretty from afar, and without more trash than one might expect, the water is brown. A large brown river empties into the ocean just north of this beach. We would not swim here nor even get into the water.......period.  This bay looks worse than the ocean front of Colombo. Is the entire west coast polluted?  I don't know, but both places have brown water. The only clear blue sparkling water, we  saw in Sri Lanka was in Trincomalee and that was wonderful...go there. We were so disappointed in this beach that, we cut our stay short and left the island early.
The beach is beautiful and great for surfing with those massive waves from the Indian Ocean. The sand is fine and no dirt...it's clean. I experienced no hawker's here.

I really love the Bentota beach - it's free of the bars and pubs, just full stretch of soft golden sand. There are also sun beds and short surf boards for use - and I believe they are free! I came alone here, with my bags and mat, and I left it there alone most of the time while being in the water. It was so safe! The sea is also shallow up to 40m away from shore! Would highly recommend anyone to be here if you like peace and tranquility.
Go here. Long, calm beach with white sand and beautiful surroundings. Great place to surf, you can rent surfboards at the beach aswell.
Very quiet /tranquille. Nice waves. Very warm water but not clear. We were at the end of April, maybe is different in the high season. Nice hotels and terraces around for lunch.

The Beach is lovely with beautiful sand. Take care while in the water as the ocean was quite rough. I would not let children in the water without an adult with them. There are a few different areas to swim
Nice quite beach. Amazing sunset. Safe and no one disturbs you, while in other places we got disturbed by the tuk tuk drivers.
A nice & clean beach and very quiet. Enjoyed the morning walks across the beach and the ocean was warmer than the hotel pool.

So we were lucky to stay on the southern side of the beach. This I would say is the quality end, simple quiet and lovely, the bit around the headland is less quality and more down market. Would I recommend it, well half of it.
A very safe beach specially if you are traveling with children. And in between if you want to rejuvenate there is a super Ayuvedic Spa (Chitra's Ayurweda) 2 mins from shore.

This beach is a little walk from the main road but it is totally worth it. Located just next to the train station and surrounded by palm and pineapple trees, this was one of the less crowded and of the more beautiful beaches of Sri Lanka
It's a beautiful beach, not many people when we were there and we really had a beautiful sunset there.

I went jogging alone this beach every morning when staying in Bentota, so lovely. Never too busy, some local runners, some fishermen, very clean beach as well. Great spot for sunset to, with the glass of sparkling.
Very clean and nice beach. No rubbish and well maintained. Nice to walk along. The water is very warm!
Bentota beach is clean and beautiful. Beach is about 10-30 meters in width. Not so crowded and don't know how safe as we did not noticed life savers on duty.
Walked the beach first thing in the morning before breakfast. It's long and sandy. Be careful though, the sun burns very easily.
The Beach is one of the nicest beach in Sri Lanka, very calm waves and very relaxing! Do yourself a Favor and relax there for a few days to recharge your batteries.
Amazing beach, amazing ocean, not crowded, calm, very clean, place fro a good morning run as well as for day out with kids and for a romantic evening.
A great beach which is very clean and well maintained. Huge waves and good views of surfers and fishing activities
A very clean and calm beach with soft sand. Ideal for kids to enjoy the sea. A lovely place to take lots of pictures too :)

Lovely big beach reminds me of the big empty beaches of Australia. It's a nice place but there is simply nothing to do to be blunt. My advice is to jump on the train for an hour and head to Hikkaduwa where there is plenty of bars, restaurants, shops and more importantly surfing.
Lovly beach alot of bar and resturant good place to forget all the world. Very good wave to do serfing
Fantastic lovely long beach ..can not enjoy much some time of the day as you can not walk few steps without being approached by a beach boy

Its beautiful beach with white sand. Good for morning and evening walks. But a true fact its a dangerous beach, one can't swim in that beach. We had visited in month of October which was not right time to enjoy the beach being high water currents. No water sports activities takes place here. One who just wants to relax can visit Bentota and stay in one of the hotel as most of the hotel has  direct access to this beach.
It's a beautiful stretch but impossible to swim in. Clean and swanked by hotels and resorts through its length.

We stayed at the Centara Ceysand Spa & Resort for our vacation in Bentota. We had a direct access to the beach which was right across our room. It is a clean beach and very good to play in the sand or walk with your kids, The sea was a bit rough but no harm in playing with kids on the shore. My kids thoroughly enjoyed being there and were refusing to get back to the hotel. I am sure I will not get tired of Bentota beach.
If this beach was in Europe it would have been crowded. Here there was a lot of space. Constantly 27 centigrades,  nice waves to dive into and the most beautiful and clean sand.
Excellent sandy beach; Safe. Had good time with morning and evening walks. Sea is not rough, and for most part it is not deep as well. Had good time - not many people around as well.
Benton Beach is really the best attraction. It's really one of the best beach I have been to. Not that safe to swim but it's good for walk specially in the afternoon

The beach was awesome, it was choppy yet the views were great, we got some awesome pics here and the swim was good too. i recommend people to stay at hotels by the beach to get quick access and be able to do long walks here
A child friendly beach with soft sand. One of the best I found in Sri Lanka. I was on this private side   Part of Centara hotel. But even the public side is as good and clean.

an unspoilt long stretch of sandy beach that is great for walking/running/sunbathing on. sunbeds aren't set out, there are a handful to rent but overall the beach is unspoilt and its lovely to see rather than a beach with lines and lines of sunbeds and umbrellas. as big hotels boarder the beach there are no independent bars or restaurants, just the ones from hotels.
It was a very beautiful calm and clean beach these days of the year. Sea bath is possible with kids. Can walk in more than 50m in to the sea without a problem
It is a really long beach with shallow water levels in the beginning. Going on sunset would be ideal in this beach

This beach when we visited was very clean. No rubbish at all. It has some great restaurants close by for lunches and evening meals. The sea could be a little  dangerous for children as it has a powerful undercurrent and big waves

Unspoilt, calm, quiet and stunning. Whatever the Sri Lankan government are doing to protect this beach from falling foul of tourism like many of the southern beaches, long may it continue! This beach a a few kilometres long and stretches far out to sea. Beautiful soft sand and waves that are great for bodyboarding/jumping waves. No infrastructure on the beach so shade hard to come by but love the fact it feels natural. Beach used by tourists as well as locals especially families at weekends and after work. Some people selling tours/gifts but all very polite and will leave you be should you wish. Stunning for sunset.
Beautiful beach, sea was rough at this time of year from late morning was recommended not to swim out far.

beautiful long white sandy beach. woman travellers alone do get hassled by hawkers and locals trying to sell goods or coax you to use their transport/guide services. it gets busy on sundays with local also visiting for the weekend but quieter on weekdays

This is an extensive beach stretching for miles. The sea was high all the time we were in Bentota, so the waves were pounding on the beach, which was a lovely sound in the dark. May be safe when the sea is calmer, but didn't look too safe in a high sea. However nice and peaceful for a walk.

The view of the beach, crystal clear water, not much depth sea, and the hotels and restaurants nearby make this place too cheeky. If anyone visit down south of Sri Lanka, a place which must be visited.
beach front wassuper clean and had a great walk along the beach.Although the sea was rough one part of it had a long stretch to walk
wow! nice and clean beach. lot of people enjoy and very safety because life grads in there. specially there have island corner of the beach which live in Buddhist monks

Travelling the world, now we are in Sri Lanka. this is the most boring place on earth. Spice gardens are all fake. turtle farm is a joke. beaches are dirty. staff in a 5 star hotel doesn't understand anything what you ask or order.... For us, never again
Clean water, smooth sand, wherever you look you will see a paradisiacal view The coconut trees are all along the beach

Coming from other beaches in the south - we were really disappointed by this beach.  There is a lot of garbage littered along the sand.  Also there are only big hotel resorts beach side so it is a challenge to find reasonably priced food.  I would recommend Unawatuna or Tangalle over this beach.  In my opinion skip it and head more south!

One of the best beaches I travelled to and you won't expect it while before crossing the river. The hustle and bustle of the town disappears and you are in a serene, beautiful and tranquil setting. Clean, safe to swim in and quiet. Will return!
Our lodging was at Chami Villa. They provide a place on the beach with loungers and pads for the loungers in the shade!!!
The beach is extremely beautiful especially during sunrise and sunset. It is quite clean and there are not many local vendors here. A must visit if in Sri Lanka.

Best Beach we have seen in Sri Lanka. We only missed that we can´t go swimming because of the waves. You can go inside and jump into the Waves, but no swimming or surfing. But maybe at another traveltime it is better.
Nice beach for a morning or afternoon walk. Although must be vigilant for touts and what are referred to as 'beach boys' who hassle for money etc.

Whilst staying at the avani Bentota we spent a lot of time walking along the beach. One time we were fortunate enough to see a pair of turtles. This time of year the wind is onshore so the sea is very rough.

A beautiful beach and wonderful walks provided you walk without bags so the sellers dont hassle you. The outfall is close in so the sea is filthy - you could not swim in it. The effluent is a huge area and very obvious. The weekends the beach is packed with the locals who go in the sea further along. if you want a perfect beach go to Langkawi.
One of the best beaches in Sri Lanka. Really clean and quiet place. Though it's not safe to swim because of the strong currents. Good place to watch the sun set.

I went there it wan very nice weather and the sand was very soft. The only issue there is that the prices are high in the restaurants there and only  Foreigner can afford to buy from there. Be carful there you can take the price down.

If one stay at one of the boutique hotels along the south side heading towards Galle, one will get a more pleasanter view of the beach with not too many people visiting it. The beach is very clean and the water is wonderful.
Spent three days in Bentota. Awesome experience. Almost secluded, clean beach... Sand is soft. Warm water... Slow gradient makes it very safe...

We Stayed in the hotel along with two othar freinds in September. The staff at the reception and Resturant were great to talk to & helpfull.. The tolets & rooms need to be refurbished .Specially the Toilets are drab and not very clean. The food was excellent and good spread,

Bentota Beach is a great Beach for a walk and would be all the more beautiful if it wasn't for the disgusting amount of litter all along the beach, it's so disappointing to see it in such a horrible state, and what a wonderful setting and how romantic it would be to watch the amazing sunset if it was cleaned up 😢 Anne, Singapore
I had an amazing 5 nights at Bentota beach, at the end of my Sri Lanka trip. It was very clean and nice and quiet.

Stunning beach with not many people around. For us though we found it too hot to sunbathe in the sun and the waves too rough to swim in, ok for cooling off. Sri Lanka does not have quiet med style coastlines, it is not in my opinion suitable for families or children. There are better options for them elsewhere. Really Sri Lanka is ideal for couples who enjoy tours,traveling,nature and peaceful beauty.
the sea was quite rough but lovely to jump the waves needed it to cool off as the pools were warm nice to go for long quiet walks.
Paddles in the sea, very warm and clean but the waves were huge and very strong which is expected for this time of year so swimming is very dangerous!
very very nice beach in sri lanaka and very clean and blue ,, so much waves and not to swim there in the ocean
Of the most beautiful views of the sunset from the beach of bentota with ocean And to walk with causing waves on foot

Wow, amazing long beach with wonderful sand to walk on.  The wild ocean waves make it dangerous this time of year to swim in, however can go in but only a shallow depth. Great walking with the ocean sounds and wonderful ocean breeze.
Fantastic wide golden sand that was deserted, great for a long walk by the sea. Sea was a little wild when we were there, and was red flagged because of the waves and undercurrent.
A very clean beach and the Indian Ocean was very warm, I would not recommend swimming though as it was very rough.

I stayed at nearby Resort for two nights and took the opportunity not to miss long stroll in the morning as well as in the evening. Despite such a expansive horizon and blueish clean waters, the beach in unusually deserted and free from crowds.There are not many restaurants except that of temporary eateries set up by beach side hotels.Whatever information I got from the hotel where I was staying there are some safety issues to be taken care.Overall it's one of the scenic beachs at Southern tip of Sri Lanka.

Very clean since all water activities are forbidden and shifted to the nearby river. There are no life guards so you have to be careful and supervise your kids. Near our hotel (Vivanta by Taj), there are trainers offering some surfing lessons and they are very good and offer their services at affordable prices. A walk by the sea at sunset is a must experience adventure.
Beach is good ...very clean.. sea rather rough so good for surf sport and not recommended  for swimming .....locals very friendly and it is used by them plus tourists and local dogs too

Awesome expanse of the beach. The Indian Ocean roar is pulsating. Not crowded at this time of the year. Some vendors but no harrassing vendors trying to push their wares. Great place for beach volleys and group games. No beachside cafes  or shacks! Be mindful of jelly fish, you could come across the occasional one!

I went to this beach for a morning walk , It is a nice and clean beach and has lot of hotels and resorts lined up next to it. After you walk further one can see nice non crowded beach . All you need a your sun block and a good  book to read

After 4 days wondering around Sri Lanka, me and my friend decided to go to Bentota (as it is only 2:30 hours from the international airport) and relax. It was a good decision as the beach is quite clean, not to many people at that time and the sea was nice. There are also a few nice restaurants to visit in the city. But besides the beach and enjoying yourself there is not much to see.
Also known as Golden Beach, I thoroughly enjoyed by visit on this beach, collected so many shells and loved being there.

Familiar only with the portion of public Bentota beach behind Centara Ceysands Hotel, beautiful long stretch of beach. Entrance from hotel side is well signposted, relevant to current season tide and danger. The current is quite rough, vigorous at this time, but still a beautiful part of the Indian Ocean.  Just loved wading at the waters edge  and it was great for  my swollen feet.  Hopefully, I'll get a chance to return.

The beach in front of Surf hotel is nice and clean with soft white sand. The waves are not very high and it is generally quite safe for swimming. Sports activities are available either through your resort and even some private operators.

Beautiful beach, Endless Streches, perfect place in Bentota to enjoy beautiful sunset while sipping a can of beer.  Beach has quite a few people.  so you can spend good quality time with yourself and enjoy the sound of waves.  Not advisable to swim, as times waves becomes quite dangerous.
could be doing with a clean up but otherwise a nice beach and not busy.  Most days have the beach to ourselves which was really nice
Perfect for surfing sunbathing or purely relaxing and watching the amazing sunsets of Sri Lanka ... night's to remember

Endless stretches of very clean sand along a good stretch of the Indian Ocean. Not too many "looky-looky" sellers if you stay down by the waters edge. Very quiet beach really only used by a few people from the hotels especially this time of year as the sea is too rough for safe bathing. Step back from the beach and you will find plenty of litter and rubbish as is the norm for Sri Lanka.
Stunning beach in a stunning country! Sandy beach, the waves are quiet large even in the late summer!

Whilst we did not swim in the sea due to the Moonson season we understand it is very pleasant other times of the year. Easy access from hotels. One end of the beach is near the river mouth which is interesting.
Even the sea was very rough I really enjoyed staying at Bentota beach. There was not so many tourists because it was off season but perfect timing for a proper rest.

Stunning sandy beach great for long walks with beautiful views along the way. tropical green trees all along very choppy out of season but still very warm and safe to swim up to waist height before lunchtime after that time it gets too dangerous to swim in

It is one of the most beautiful beaches in Sri Lanka and it's still remaining very clean unlike most beaches in down south. An early morning visit to the beach would not disappoint you at all and find yourself in peace and freedom. Sand is very smooth and clean and also the sight is very pretty full of greenery. You can take the 6.55 a.m. Galle train from Pettah in Colombo and enjoy a ride of one and half hours to Bentota and the beach is right opposite to the station!
this is one of the beautiful beaches of the Sri lanka. clean water, nice views, basically its a perfect place for everyone.
A great place to walk.  Very soothing, clean.  Water was very clean.  It was off season while we were there and the water was choppy.  But it was fun nonetheless.

Although sea was rough,  still some of the nicest softest sand I have come across... Almost like quick sand.  Beach was clean and didn't get much hassle from people wanting to sell things. Lovely place to walk up and down and think an afternoon away.
We likeed this beach. It is very long, the view is great and lots of greenery along the beach. There alot of turles places.
A lovely beach for a walk and a paddle but often unsafe for swimming. Litter is a big problem but some of it is washed up.
One of the bestestt beaches everrrrr. Where I come from (OMAN), we also have clean and beautiful beaches, but Bentota? So peaceful and serene. Going to visit this area again, definitely!
I spent every day of my holiday here it is one of the nicest beaches I've ever seen. My 7 year old daughter loved it
A very nice clean beach. The sea was a bit rough and we did enjoy a long walk. Found the tout  very money as he was selling purs rubbish. What a bloke and did take no in the end
Almost a "jungle beach!!" lovely long sandy beach although not really suitable for swimming

We were staying in Centara Resort and Spa and one morning we decided to go for a morning walk at 7 am. Two Red Flags were up so no swimming was allowed. Remove the shoes/sandals let the feel of sand and sea soak up your feet. Absolutely clean beach. We didn't encounter any thing which may hurt your foot. The Waves were magical. If you are staying nearby do take that beautiful morning walk here.
For us from Chennai (second longest beach in the world) this was not inspiring.  OK one can spend sometime having come to Bentota

We stayed at the Cinnamon Beach Hotel which has direct access to this beach. It is a beautiful stretch of sand to look at for a few photos but that's it. IT IS TOO DANGEROUS to swim here, there are strong under currents and no lifeguards. The waves roll in thick and fast and were like Newquay in Cornwall. Definitely not the place to take kids but they also warned adults to stay well within their depth. IT LOOKS POLLUTED and the water is brown and frothy. Obviously the strong current churns up the sand but it also looks dirty and our travel agent advised us to swim here. We were told that the lagoon to the rear of the hotel would be a great substitute but this is not the case. Its great for watersports but took deep and wide too swim in. Not that you would want to swim around speeding jet skis etc... SELLERS on the beach here are particularly persistent. There is obviously some understanding that prevents them from entering the hotels but I made the mistake of entering into polite conversation and telling one woman my name and that i was from London, she then spotted me the next day and spent 30mins calling my name from the beach and trying to get my attention to by batik wrap arounds so beware! The beach is very fine sand but no shells or beach combing - we lost interest pretty fast and stayed in hotel pool. Lots of annoying ravens too. keep landing right next to you. Quite persistent like gulls - didn't like them at all. There is also a deceptively gusty on-shore breeze, lovely to keep you that bit cooler - but would be easy to burn here so take care.
This beach had lovely sand and waves that were like tsunamis! (Thankfully not though!) It has warm waters with great marine life.
This beach is a wonderful glamorous, you can enjoy your time there and this beach mostly not crowded which gives u privacy.

Bentota Beach is perfect place for relax and sun bath. Because large sandy area. Monday to Friday is very good and weekends is little busy with local people's. I like to come back to Bentota again in my next vacation. Ayubowan!!!

Perfect. That all really. Clean as a whistle. I walked the length of rhe beach twice a day for 2 weeks. The only thing i found was a puffa fish laying on this beach. I felt safe. And at peace here.  I could actually live on this beach! ;)
I visited the beach in August, very high tides for swimming. Must be great for surfing maybe. Not much water sports facilities available.
Beautiful but no safe swimming whilst we were there. Clean long stretch of soft sand and adjacent to our hotel The usual hawkers but they were polite

The beach is very dirty, we have walked a few miles and it's quite dirty everywhere, even in front of some of the hotels. The goverment charging high tourist taxes or even the big hotels charging 130-300$ per night should look after the beach!!! What an awful shame that such beautiful stretch of beach is covered in rubbish. The beach is also very quiet so it may not suit everyone. Liferally, nobody on the beach, feels quite depressing, especially after returning from lively Mirissa beach. Good for someone who likes to read and get away from people. There are no places to eat, no nice restaurants or coffee shops and prices are higher than in other places such as Mirissa or Ella. We ended up eating in the hotel as there were no places to eat. There is no village/town. Water too rough to swim. More beach boys than in other places bothering you all the time and trying to sell you stuff. Having visited many countries and beaches, I was not impressed at all with this beach.
Yes August is during the western monsoon so the sea is brown and wild and although one man swam most just watched. The beach was windswept and a little melancholy.
place is nice for beach lovers ....but 2 days would be more than enough. sea is rough for swimming....river tour is nice but over priced...dutch area is awsome place for earing.
Lovely beach, very quiet with golden sand.  The sea was quiet rough but it was right at the end of the monsoon season.
If you're looking for a secluded beach, then look no further. I walked 5km along the beach and only saw one other person, although admittedly it was half in a storm.
just around 100 km from airport. taxi cost RS 8000. very nice beach . there are many kind of hotels , restaurants are available for reasonable price. also you can do the boat ride in river nearby

It was a clean and beautiful beach with yellow gold sand. It was not too populated, so we could easily find a spot to chill and relax in and leisure. The sea was a bit rough so we had been warned not to attempt swimming in it. It was green immediately after the beach so it was a strange green and gold beach with the beautiful cloudy sky the greeted us in Bentota. loved every minute of it. Walking on the beach, chatting with the great friendly people there. Just enjoying the surreal beauty of it all
didn't stay here long, water was a bit too rough to swim in today but at least the beach seemed clean along this stretch in front of our hotel.
The Beach is perfect for long walks and is a pleasure to the eyes. But beware of beach boys who tries to sell clothings and lure for other unwanted activities and asking to click your photos.
Nice Pristine beach close to the Villa and other hotels, Sand and water are clean and enjoyable. Not sure of the water sports on the beach but did see some water scooters.
Visited in July.  It wasn't suitable for swimming but was quiet and clean.  Had a lovely visit here.   Where are all the tourists?
Amazingly clean beach with spectacular view. We went during the rainy season so the green trees , rough white ocean , dark clouds gave us the scenery to remember .
We stayed at Bentota for 3 nights, and weren't really fascinated by the beach. It is okay and there isn't much place to eat either. The only plus is that there is water sports activity.

Staying at the Centara Ceysands, Bentota Beach was on our doorstep. We were fortunate to have an ocean facing room so could witness some truly breathtaking sunsets. The sand is soft underfoot, although in July the water was a bit too choppy to swim in.
Wonderful Large Beach but now there is high tides and the sanding is washing away
The Beach is neat & clean, waves are a bit aggressive, we really enjoyed playing with waves, need to take care though as there are no coast guards
We had a BBQ out on the beach for my daughter's birthday. It was festive, fun and an excellent experience.

As it's post monsoon season the waves are huge so it's not safe to swim however we enjoyed playing up to waist height, not suitable though for small children as the current is strong. Beach practically deserted which was also a bonus!
Another fine place to stay & unwind yourself. Looks stunning after the refurbishments. An ideal place to just read a book in the large garden area

Hotel, modern design and well designed. Good sfeer, friendly people, high glass rated. Rooms are well designed and comfortabel. Free WIFI for more devises, in the hole building and garden. Beautifull pool and near to the beach. Restaurant 6 stars! Breakfast lunch and dinner! Small wine choose.
Lovely beach with great sunset although sea can be a bit rough at this time of year. Just have to be aware of the flag system.
We were there in June so it was off season. More so it was high tide and we were warned not to enter the rough waters. The water and beach are clean enough just to have a stroll by the shore.

The beach is lovely. We were there in July so it was off season and there was a fair bit of plastic rubbish scattered around. Don't know if its cleared up in high season. The water was very rough and we were warned that there is a nasty rip tide so don't go out of your depth. You will be approached by friendly Sri Lankans while on the beach. They engage you in conversation but ultimately they will be trying to sell you something. Usually a tour or a visit somewhere. It gets a bit irritating after a while as even a polite 'no thanks' does not deter them.
Lovely pristine quiet beach with white sands. Great water sports from parasailing to water scooter and many excursions around the beach
windy this time of year, nice sandy beach, clean and neat, good for surfing this time of year June-Aug;
Clean beach, great waves and beautiful sunsets!!! Can't wait to return to this excellent location. Even the people selling tours were friendly.

Beautiful beach, great people in the area. Bear in mind that between the months of May and August the waters are rough and not recommended for swimming.  I am told Hikkadua beach, although often very busy is better for swimming year round due to Coral Reefs cutting out the rough water season. Bentota is beautiful and less busy. Be sure to come outside of summer months and you will be fine.
Bentota beach is peaceful, clean and simply lovely. I didn't spend much time on the beach simply because June was too hot and humid for the same. Go in good weather and simply be a beach bum!

The beach at Bentota is beautiful and unspoilt. Great to look at and to watch the surf crashing onto the sand. It makes a fantastic sound too. As with many beaches in the Indian Ocean though it is frequently not safe for bathing due to the sea conditions and undertow
This beach was just in front of our hotel. The beach is very clean with golden sand. There are a lot of hotels on this beach. We spent hours at this beach. View is very good.
Must go if you travel to sri lanka, great restaurants, B&B, and good people. Be careful from the crazy beach guides and tuk tuk drivers.
Quite a secluded beach and feels a bit too deep to swim. Nice lighthouse nearby thats worth visiting.
This beach is clean, and beautiful.  Not crowded and is most beautiful to visit in the morning and afternoon.

We were disappointment in this beach. One of the most beautiful of the world? I dont think so! There were no one. Very dangerous place -very steep bed in the water and big wave! But! We saw turtles and it was so magical!! We were alone on the beach and went with owner of our hotel with lights. This is the only plus of this place. City was dirty and full of annoying people.
beach not maintained well at all. A large part of the beach was covered in sea weed. However this is possibly due to the fact that i visited during the Monsoon season.

Six years ago we stayed at this hotel.   The food was superb the only reason we did not return was the staff attitude in the bar area. This visit to Sri Lanka we visited for their buffet meal and again it was excellent.   The staff in the reception and dining room were again welcoming and seemed surprised we had returned (still an all inclusive hotel) for the food alone. We did go into the bar for a 'pre dinner' drink and sadly they do not welcome and again we were ignored for the first 10 minutes. I can't comment on the rooms but the food was very good.   We had a bottle of wine and in all the hotels/restaurants as wine is imported the  cost is around 3,500 rupees for a Chilean white.

Bentota is one of the better sea side destinations I've been. One of the better places in Srilanka to be. Amazing sea face and very clean. Serene beauty, awesomely relaxing and romantic. The hotel was exactly on the beach (around 50 meters from the sea). Amazing place...must visit.

Bentota beach is a beautiful beach which needs attention from the resorts sharing it. All sorts of trash is spread all over and no one seems to be interested in cleaning it up..  The resorts are living with the beach and it is their duty to keep it clean...

The beach is very clean and very pictureesque. You would get wonderful photograph. Normally year around water is blue but when we went, it was little brownish due to the rain. Still it felt very clean. You can take a speed boat ride where you can see river meeting the arabian sea. It is a sight worth to see. On left side of the beach there is a green water lagoon which is also worth checking out.
totally picturesque beach with swim friendly water for about 500 meters into the sea. Surf friendly waves. excellent for kids above 5 years
A beautiful, well maintained, well lit beach. Most luxury hotels have private access to the beach, thus ensuring the presence of life guards, clean towels and shacks near the beach

The beach is very nice, aligned with palm trees and other tropical vegetation. We went in june, so the sea was quite rough, but good enough for a little dip. The sunset is lovely. At the end of the beach, there is a little temple, but the monk was very rude. He said to us: if you don't have money, you must go. We were willing to make a donation, but after that.....Very inaproriate for a monk, don't you think?
Perfect for a walk in the morning or evening. Really loved the beach and the lovely blue water. The view of the sunset is amazing.

I have been to Benthota beach at least 10 times before and thought of making this note. Its one of the best beaches in the country. During off season it gets rough but during seaaon (Nov - March) its quite nice. The picture is from off season and its not advisable to swim during off season. You can do kite surfing here and it gets connected to the river too a few meters away from where we were.

We went to this beach during the afternoon as it was a bit hot to walk on the beach. We walked a long way and went past Taj Vivanta. That side of beach was really good and not many people were there. It had beautiful rocks, perfect location for photographs.
Perfect Sea, real warm and clean water, very comfortable to swim. Near Bentota beach hotel. Also a very good weather.
The beach are wide and clean. The sand is red brown! Soft and pleasant to walk :) The waves can be high, so watch out for the current. Not good place to snorkeling but great place to swim.
The beach was clean but like any other... one neds to go really a long way inside to fullly immerse onesself and that can be dangerous...
Beautiful, tranquil, sandy beach ideal for an early morning or evening stroll and dip your toes in the water although it can be rough to swim in.
Beautiful sereen and unspoilt. ......some can be quite crowded....but it wornt be hard to find you own spot.....
Very quiet /tranquille. Nice waves. Very warm water but not clear. We were at the end of April, maybe is different in the high season. Nice hotels and terraces around for lunch.

Such a lovely endless sandy beach, I could just sit there for days and days, a whole week and still i feel bad that i came back home, you can never have enough of it, so peaceful and relaxing, love it to the max..
Lovely  beach, very quiet, beware of the power of the sea (never experienced anything like that before)

Visit to bentota beach was a wonderful experience for us. Clean, sparkling waters would welcome you n one can spend a whole sunny afternoon on the beach. Not much crowded, very approachable and close to nature. A must visit place for tourists visiting Sri Lanka

A scenic place in the town of Bentota. A large stretch of sandy beach along the coast line. Ideal to spend the evening time, enjoying the sea breeze and the sunset. The beach is very clean but one needs to beware of the occasional strong tides. The beach has amenities of washroom and a rescue station.

We were not the water sport/adventure types. The rain made our life a little miserable too. But the beach was clean (in most places) and as they say you never know what the tides can bring in. (one morning there were a lot of plastic water bottles all over the place). There a couple of good restaurants/shacks as well.
Bentota beach is just beautiful. It's between some star properties and is very clean. A quiet walk along is recommended.

We traveled to Benton for a day at the beach. The beach is beautiful with warm rich sand. The tide is so strong that the shells have been ground into the sand. It feels as though it is like sand from a spa as we dug our feet and arms into it before heading to the water to rinse off. The water was nice and warm. Due to the time of year, the tide was very strong as the rainy season was approaching. The beach is wide and natural. There is a rescuer station near the area of the beach we visited and a rinsing station close by as well.
Really so beautiful on this beach.just a brilliant view across the Indian ocean.I have been on 3 times it really is a lovely walk too.
Very clean beach with blue Saffire  water . Waves were mild so had a nice peaceful time at beach .really relaxing

This is one of the most beautiful beaches in southern coast of Sri Lanka. It’s shallow but sometimes the sea would be rough but most of time it’s swimming friendly. And also there is an adjacent bay where you can do some watersports. But this can’t be recommended for surfers as you can’t get good waves but still you can do some surfing.
This is a quiet beach that makes for good walking (but not really for swimming). In some places there is a quite a bit of garbage, though, especially closer to the shoreline.
Nice sandy beach to relax and enjoy food and fresh juices in one of the big "beach huts". Swimming can be hazardous.
If you need quiet and peaceful beach, then you will like there. You can jog quietly and alone without interruption, example at Merissa beach.
Bentota beach is one of the beat beaches in SL it's calm and shallow and even suitable for kids there are many activities such as beach volleyball, jet ski and banana boat rides
Excellent beach, clean one, We enjoyed lot during our visit on 8th may We took some nice photos there

We went onto the jetskis and had lots of fun! Please be aware there may be fraudulent people selling jetskis at a more expensive, higher rate than normal. It is best to visit the small lake inside the hotel for Jetskis.
Lovely long clean sandy beach - bay area near the rocks at the corner probably safest for swimming. Great beach to walk along.

We visited Sri Lanka in April/May, just before the monsoon, and were disappointed to hear that swimming was dangerous at this time because of rip tides. So, even though the sea looked fairly placid, I understand that it is safe for swimming only between November and February. Sri Lanka averages three drownings a day over the year. Taxi drivers told us that although we could not swim from the beach near our hotel at Kalutara, all would be great for swimming in Bentota. However, the sea looked exactly the same as in our resort and we did not see a single person swimming during our visit. I guess the drivers had said you could swim in Bentota merely to encourage us to take the trip there with them.
Beautiful and clean beach. Not much of places to eat around but has nice beach facing resorts. Do visit the beach for viewing the beautiful sunset.
An exceptionally beautiful beach right in front of my hotel. Enjoyed wave surfing here. Very neat and clean.

Stunning beach, practically empty every time we went down, private section for our hotel. Little bit of heaven. We were off season for surfing apparently but this is the place to go if surfing is your thing. Not advised for swimming due to under current. It's like walking into a bath heat wise, far superior to the med I can tell you.
Very nice and clean beach - perfect spot for the morning walk and jog. A bit tricky to get there walking from more remote B&B's, but take a cab and you will get there in no time.
As the photo shows, the broad beach of powdery sand extends for miles with hardly a soul in sight.  One of the best beaches in the world, sloping gently to the ocean, ideal for young children.

Most beautiful part about the beach is that the sea changes color every 15 minutes. depending on angle of sun. From White in morning to bright blue then aquamarine, bluie green, green in afternoon and grey in evening. Crystal clear water, plenty of authentic european restaurants as u drive south. Special recommendation for Spegatti Company in Hikkaduwa.
Best beach I've been to. Very clean with soft white sand. You can walk for miles. The water is warm and not too deep. Huge waves though.

We visited in April end and the beach was the best of all beaches in southern Sri Lanka. Absolutely clean beach, clear water, soft sand, gentle waves. We just loved it. However bentota isn't like other beaches where u get lots of beach shacks/restaurants. So if u want some quite time and peace, this is the place to be.

We went for a walk along the beach late afternoon and met a group of childern plus their teachers. Talked to them for a while and they were very interesting. Made a change from friendly locals in Colombo who were only interested in befriending you to go to somewhere to sell you something!
The beach is very very clean and it was almost like a private beach for our hotel. You can take a dip and just relax on the beached.
The ocean was warm and quietly peaceful... The best thing - no people on the SAND beach!!! Yes, everywhere is sand) I advise to visit!!!

What a beautiful beach with miles of golden sand, outside the hotels on the beach cleaners sweep the debris that has washed in overnight. Crystal clear water laps the beach. Beware of the current and rips. Body boards to hire from vendors along the beach which is backed with swaying palm trees.
Bentota Beach is a very long and wide strip of sand. It's pretty clean however it can get a bit crowded at times.
It's really nice a wide beautiful beach, great for walking, building sand castles and many other activities
We went for a early morning stroll here. Serene place. Lots of joggers use this place. The sand is lovely. Nice place to relax and read a book.

Beach is absolutely beautiful. Locals a very friendly just be cautious of the waters as the currents are very strong. Their is some litter spotted about the beach. Walking from one end to the other you can find little bars, spice gardens and massage places. Also boat trips and rentable surf boards etc.
One of the cleanest beaches I have seen in the world. there is not too much crowd too. So, if there are any team building activities or water sports to be played can be done here.
stayed for 3 nights at Hotel. Used to go for early morn walk on the beach. really enjoyed walking on the beach.
Excellent hotel with he beach view. Friendly hotel staff and superb rooms. Food is excellent with a choice of Sri Lankan and Western cousin
Beach from the movies. Great pina colada (straight from the coconut) in small bar on the beach, we also saw a couple getting married on the beach.
Bentota is a fabulous relaxing beach resort area with plenty of water sports and activities on offer and is a good base to travel around the south of the island!!

Beautiful, serene, clean and clutter and crowd free......a true beach lovers haven! Bentota gives you the solitude to enjoy the joys of the ocean without bothering or being bothered by crowds.... the locals are extremely tourist friendly, and take pains not to hassle you.
Participated in yoga on the beach. All I can say was the view was gorgeous. I would recommend visiting the Buddhist temple at the end of the beach as well.
The best part of the Sri Lankan beaches are the huge swathes of beach for everyone top enjoy on their own. Bentota is one of them. Lots of space for everyone to have fun

I commented yesterday that it was a shame that the beach had some rubbish washed up from the sea, just to say the beach is being swept as I write this review! In which case it gets 5 stars, it's excellent !
Amazing beach. Quiet. Clean. It looked like a private beach...not at all crowded, that's the best part!
nice location directly on the beach, fresh juices, good  fish :-)  and meat dishes. people are friendly and polite
lovely beach with clean water and fine sand with wavy tides..beach looks beautiful and you can enjoy activities also.
Incredibly beautiful beach overlooking the sun setting over the Indian Ocean.  Unfortunately, sea is very rough and it is dangerous to swim

Almost deserted golden beach warm water and great waves for body surfing. The helicopter rides at the end of the beach and nearby microlight rides were a little intrusive (but thankfully not often) to what would have been a stunningly quiet location with few if any pestering tat sellers.
This is the best beach in the world and it is not overclauded. The waves can be high in the mid season, but it is great in the high season
Great beach, nice white sand, high vaves. Not suitable for little children due to vaves. Amazing sunsests

What a beautiful beach this is .There are many hotels on this beach.From 5 star hotels to guest houses .Careful about the beach boys and touts.You can visit a turtle hatchery along this beach,And try a catamaran boat.
A romantic stroll, trying to take on the mighty waves, a moonlit restaurant: this beach has it all. What can you say about such a lovely location ? Had a great time on golden sands watching sunsets.

It is very nice, long but there is pretty much nothing to do at all, very expensive restaurants in resorts, basic hard wood sunloungers or none in some areas, March time is too rough to swim in the ocean so overall I would recommend to see it but not staying for too long.

Very nice beach and one of the more safe ones in Srl Lanka. Most are quite dangerous but it is fine to swim here with some care. Few facilities but there are plenty nearby including a train station at the edge of the beach itself.
Definitely one of the nicest beaches we have been in Sri Lanka. Compared to other beaches, it is large enough to cover the flood, so there is still enough space to lie on.
Piece of paradise is here.It amazes you it stunts you it attracts you.Give it a visit.It is worth.It's not crowded even in high season
The beach feels safe for swimming. It is clean and has enough waves for boarding. This is a very long stretch of fine sand beach and I would certainly recommend.

I saw the best sunset here while I'm Sri Lanka It's also very easy to swim in the sea compared to other beaches down the coast It's very quiet at night so go for sinner early Very chilled and beautiful Would recommend
The beach is lovely and pristine.  There are huge old trees that allow children to run around and play hide and seek. Sand is clear to built castles, no sharp rocks and stones.
Fantastic clean beach, the water was warm and refreshing....stayed hours in the water, only regret was that  we did not stay longer.....
We stayed 2ngts.it hads a really enjoyable time.rooms were xcellent.hotel garden are nice.pool also very clean.food also delesious.definetly recommended and would stayagain if visit to bentota.
Colombo doesn't have much to offer and neither does Galle. This place sits right in the middle of both the cities and is a must for beach lovers.
Unspoilt and paradise just as a beach should be, the sea is warm and the sand so pure, it really is amazing.
Clear water, uncrowded. Swimming is a delight. Wonderful sunsets as the sun goes down over the sea. Not too many shacks and beach boys. Delightful place.
This beach is well maintained and is extremely clean. You can opt for couple of water activities if you want. There is a nice beach hotel where you can have a meal or a quick snack during your visit.

Not crowded at all, undercurrent can get pretty crazy though. Quiet enough to camp on, friendly  and accommodating staff from hotels around. Free to use sunbed. We camped here for a dozen nights, it was great!

The beach alone provides a magnificent view.we went here after visiting hikaduwa and found that the beach area is isolated except for the few hotels that are there. wish it could have been more developed and had some more road side shops and site seeing to make it more attractive.
It is a nice beach very clean, you can enjoy long walk side by side sea. There are many hotel and restaurant along side this beach
Lovely miles of sand on Indian Ocean. Some seasonal jelly fish but views and sunsets to die for. Local railway station serves the coastal tourist resorts from Colombo and easy too use

Can't believe this beach isn't busier! We felt like we had the whole beach to ourselves some mornings! The sea is a bit choppy but for confident swimmers is great fun! Beautiful at sunset too. Grab a palm tree for shade for free, perfect. Not many BeachBoys hassle you at all, everyone nearby is very friendly. Pop over the railway tracks for great local restaurants.
A clean beach, we couldnt find so much time for enjoying the beach because of our meetings. Sand, sea, turtles are amazing<3 enjoy the sunset, waves and surfing✌
About an hour and a half's walk from one end of the beach to the other end back.  Gorgeous!

Lovely place to walk in the mornings but rather choppy waters. On our stretch there were many hotels , but all discreetly placed behind the mangroves. Luckily few  bothersome hecklers/sellers on the beach.

Lovely and quiet stretch of beach  especially after sunset. Great waves and shallow for a good few metres for wading out. We were unlucky to stand in an oil slick which was an hour or more to clean off our feet!!! But could happen on any beach I guess  :-)
Take a walk and get the real feel of a clean sea shore. Though you miss the shacks but that does helps to keep it clean
Loved playing in waves - just the right size. Lovely soft sand too. Picturesque and not too busy in March. We were staying at nearby Avani hotel so didn't need to worry about security.

The beach is huge, ideal for 'surf strolling' and spotlessly clean. The water temperature (in mid March) was like a warm bath. This is not really a beach for swimming because of dangerous undertow, but is perfect for standing up to your waist and daydreaming.

The beach itself is nice enough, but is covered in large hotels and resorts. There were very few people who actually spend time on the sand or in the water, rather sit in their deck chairs inside the hotel grounds. Has less of relaxing, chill vibe, and isn't really conducive to sunbathing and swimming unless you are at one of the resorts. It certainly doesn't have the charm of the beaches further down the coast. Places to eat are more limited, and expect to pay a hefty sum for your meals.
Stayed in hotel facing beach. Brilliant beach with long clear sand with nice warm waters to either swim in or just walk along side of. really relaxing.

We were staying at The Villa at Paradise Road & used the beach every day. It's a beautiful long beach absolutely perfect for beach walking as the sand was always very hard. The waves were awesome too which were ideal for body surfing. The best aspect of the beach was there were no crowds & most times we were the only people on the beach.

The beach is stunning and amazingly quiet. I really don't understand how there weren't more tourists there! It's a great place to have a relaxing walk and chill out. The sea is pretty rough though so watch out! We went to the Loft Bar (which was close to Avani Bentota resort and spa) which served a great range of mojitos and had some nice views for sunset. There wasn't really anywhere else to go for food along the stretch unless it was in a hotel restaurant, but they were quiet and served decent food.

Scenic beauty at its best with cleanliness personified. Staying at Taj had a direct access to the beach and it's tough to describe the feeling I had walking early in the morning on the beach.. high waves.. rocks and peace...one of the biggest highs of the trip.
Lovely Clean Beach.Amazing place for Surfing and a little bit of Snorkeling. Lots of Fun activities around ( you can try a mini Glider over the sea). Amazing place to unwind during the night.
Best place to relax, you can walk for hours along the beach, small rocks are there where you can sit and meditate...
A must visit !! One of The best beaches in Sri Lanka. This beach is my second favourite after Hikkaduwa :) nice huge waves !!
I would highly recommend travelling in Sri Lanka, lots to see, places to visit, beautiful beaches and the most friendly people in the world !

the wife and I were truly alone on this beach so much to say I lost my shorts in the ocean.being bowled over by a wave no worries here as we were really alone it took me a few minutes in the surf but I found them again has anyone ever seen 20 stone tramping around the surf looking for swimming shorts

We mostly walked around the old town of Bentota,and did some light shopping and gift buying for our friends back home.We relaxed a lot by the beautiful sandy beach,and sampled the delights of the very satisfying Indian Ocean.

This is a beautiful long sandy beach with lots of people. I went for a boat ride and saw the crocodile.it was cloudy so i could not see the sunset. I learned that this is the place where both the river and the Indian Ocean meets but do not mix.
This is a beautiful long stretch of beach with hardly anyone on it. You can walk for miles and miles. You get to it from the hotels or on a boat that takes you across the river. perfect
Beautiful beach very sandy, water sports nearby by ten minutes walk from railway station lots of lovely places to eat nearby

The bentota beach is a nature paradise especially during the sunset time. the problem is that have no place on the beach for drink a cocktail and eat something like other places in Sri Lanka have. no nightlife at all.
The beach itself is very clean and at one end is a Buddhist temple which we found very interesting to visit and talk to the monk who lives there

Bentota beach is very beautiful. However it is really missing beach bar or even beach restaurants for a nice sunset cocktail or a snack in the afternoon. Your only option for drinks and food are the expensive resorts along the beach .
This is quite a bland beach. Only a few bars and if they have sunbeds they have normally gone very early. Very boring place. I would not do Bentota again. A waste of holiday.
lovely beach to relax,not crowded at all. Ideal for relaxation after a stressful life. there are free sunbeds availble

I dont really want to leave a review about bentota beach as I want it to remain untouched. Myself and my girlfriend were based here for our 3 week stay. The both of us fell in love with it. We traveled most of Sri Lanka and always were looking forward to getting back to our beach. Some days they were nobody on it. Why this beach is deserted??????? We also spent 3 nights in the Maldives and still missed bentota beach. When we go back to Sri Lanka it will be there as it is heaven on earth
Just at the back of the hotel is a beautiful stretch of sandy beach, although not recommended for swimming. Evening walks are a must.

Lovely beach, we walked up to the bar and used their sun beds, no charge! Sea a little rough but plenty of room in the shallows for children to play. All lovely and sandy, only one lady selling sarongs of which we bought two. At one thousand rupees, £5, not expensive and very nice.
A long beach perfect for long walks.. various hotels line the beach with different restaurants either indoors or close by making it  nice romantic walk to dinner.
I wonder why you don't see many people on this beautiful sandy beach. Very clean and safe. In some areas you can rent sunbeds.

Wonderful white sandy beach, some sun beds available to hire per day. The ocean is warm, but be careful of the very strong currents. Lots of beach sellers but they don't really hassle. Absolutely stunning sunsets at times.
if your visiting sri lanka must visit bentota beach, so many restaurants around. :) plenty of water sport activities..

Beautiful beach, some areas safe for swimming, but always a good idea to let the beach boys know you have gone out as they will keep an eye on. Lots of water activities available including surfing and jet skis. A beautiful temple which is worth a visit at the bottom end (past Bentota Beach Hotel) Keep a look out for turtles that lay their eggs in the evening.

Nice quiet place you have to go looking for things to do but lovely, only disappointing thing was massage at laluna cost us 50 Australia each and had better 2 dollar massage chairs at airport. My guy just yawned all way though it and didn't give a toss very disappointed never go back again my partner massage was the same
Clean, broad and not crowded beach. Good for romantic walks during sunset or distant thunderstorm. Will return.

The beach is approx 4 mile long. A little busy I front of the big hotels but can find a secluded spot easily. The water has some strong currents in areas but towards the north end there is a big sand bar with calm shallow water. The water was beautiful and clear. A few beach guys offer surf lessons and boat tours. A few but not too many vendors selling sarongs
A very clean beach, relatively light sand. A lot of trees and enough shadow to hide from the Sun. Much better then in Negombo.
an awesome place for relaxation as well as water sports activities. the beach is very clean and lovely shades of green and blue
This sea is clean with beautiful waves. This beach is perfect for long walks. The only con is that there is no beach service or restaurants.

My second visit to Bentota Beach Hotel was a bit of disappointment. The maintainaince was not proper and small annoyances like a leaking AC in the room or lights not working or wash basin clogging up appeared. Otherwise it's a very good hotel with all facilities and a beautiful beach.

I do recommend, , beach  perfect for long walks and sea safe for swimming. Be aware not everywhere in Sri Lanka safe swimming is obvious! Good for kids, not so crowded, no dogs, clean!!! Nice,small restaurants and places for a massage. I stayed in  Sea Rock Villa- lovely place.
very clean, there are  no dogs, good for children, perfect for long walk, no beach servis, no restaurants

We've spent a couple of days here and liked it very much. It's not so crowded like some other places like Mirissa for example. A nice final spot to end your vacation just before Colombo. But Talalla beach was definitely our favorite beach of Sri Lanka.
Loved the beach and the restaurants and bars by it. However, quite touristy and crowded throughout the day - Induruwa beach is a good alternative !

This is the best beach I have visited in the area. It could do with some beach shacks for a drink as unless you are staying in one of the hotels that line the front of the beach you are a bit stuck. Good shallow water and not as rough as the other beaches. Looking forward to going back.
This is a lovely long sandy beach which is used by turtles for nesting. It is truly lovely. Currents are strong and dangerous however and in places it is spoilt with litter.
Very deep beach, and you can walk out quite a ways in the water before it gets deep. The beach is clean and quiet. A great place to relax.
Beautiful clean beach one of the best in Sri Lanka.fantastic for snorkelling and deep sea diving. Lush
I had a fabulous elephant ride on Bentota beach. My hotel organized it for me. There were lots of people on the beach playing volley ball. The sand is so fine - just like Melbourne's sand.

The sandy beach was long, clean and very natural. There were a few beach bars and hotels which blended well into the trees beyond the sand. The sea was warm, the waves were sometimes very strong so not for the weaker swimmer. It was a great place for an early morning or evening walk.
Nice and quiet and gets a little more busy with the hotel crowd as you head towards the bridge. A decent clean beach.

Its nice to come in the afteroon because in the morning sun is extremely strong and unless you pay at least 5 $ for umbrella you wont get it. There are a lot of local couples and families but they are verry nice and friendly. You can easilly get a thukthuk or catch a train, goilettes are for free, mostly clean, showers too but the water is warm.
This very clean beach is good for a run or stroll along, only recently have some loungers escaped their hotel confinement and encroached upon this largely unspoilt space.

No words to describe the Indian Ocean.. Crystal clear blue/green water! This is a place I would recommend to every individual travelling to Sri Lanka. Secluded beaches & entry only for people occupying the resorts.. Perfect destination for every couple.
Had a great time on Bentota beach ... Its a lot more commercial than Yala but has some good opportunities for snorkelling and swimming!
Lovely beach. Rough waters and a little rocky too but, otherwise it's a great vibe! Some great water sports here too
Great beach for a walk, in either direction, plenty of beach Cafes to stop for refreshments along the way. Many of the cafes offer beach chairs and umbrellas if you Wang to stay lknger

Its a beautiful and clean beach with crystal clear water. The water was warm,and the waves were manageable. Life guards were there, and they make you feel safe. The surf hotel is nearby, and also the Loft, if you are tired of playing with the water, you can grab a beer or two, while enjoying the view. Amazing experience.
Clean. The sand was lovely. For the four days we were there, the waves were too rough to swim but nice enough to jump around in.

Beautiful beach with a special attraction. If you walk on the beach towards the north, past the helicopter landing place, there is a small green hill with a Buddhist monastery on the top. like in other temples go barefoot, knee and shoulders covered.  You will be received by the single single monk of this monastery. A beautiful place for enjoyment and meditation, more a Zen ambiente than the typical more busy typical Buddhist temples. Walk the small paths with  brushed fine sand, enter a cave to pray, visit the  Stufa and overlook the bay. Do not forget to give some money to the monk, he lives from donations.
Beach walk was fantastic. The hotel should have more variety of veg food. The people over there ware very kind enough to help .
Awesome, relaxing, beautiful coastal line with its blue water that takes your heart away. And you have multiple options for varieties of adventure sports to would want to try your hands on..!!!
Won't to be by yourself ,this is the place for you .miles of beach no one much to be seen .watch the rip tides
Nice beach! Great place to explore under water world which is breath taking . Talk to right guys and you will get the best deal

The sand is soft, the sea is warm, and the bars are friendly. It is quiet and could be almost perfect. If only some of the litter got picked up it pretty much would be perfect. I wouldn't let children or weak smimmees do much more than paddle though. The waves can be powerful. Listen to the licals to find out which areas to avoid and which are safe.

Enjoyable beach, very clean with a few good seafood restaurants all it.. Fantastic for early morning or late evening strolls went the sun isn't too hot. Some of the restaurants have sun beds and will bring drinks down from the bar to your bed for a small charge.
The beach is long, beautiful and unspoilt with a surprising lack of people.  Swimming is not recommended as currents are strong and dangerous.

Bentota is a resort city. The resorts are great and there are some good restaurants around as well as good diving but no shops, local spas or casual cafes. Unawatuna is a much better place if you want to wander, browse and cruise

This is the first beach which comes on your way when you move away from Colombo. This works for its advantage and hence this is the only beach where you will find good 5 star properties. This place is more about enjoying yourself inside your property as there is nothing much to do or visit in Bentota. Pure vegetarian people need to be a bit cautious as very limited vegetarian food is available and even the regular fried veg items use the same oil used for non veg
The bentota beach is excellent for a great time in the water and for water sports. had a good time with my family in the beach. Highly recommended.

I caveat this by admitting I'm Australian. This beach is pretty poor. It is long and straight, however there was an abundance of riptides and crashing waves rather than more acceptable swimming conditions. Beaches further south are much better.
Superb beech a few steps away from Centara resort, some surfing waves but watch out for currents. Warning flags in operation.

I have never stayed at a hotel with a public beach, so this was an absolute treat of a beach... beautiful, clean, endless, soft white sand beach with the waves of the Indian ocean lapping in. Our hotel was on the beach with easy access and no hassle from the locals or beach sellers. Sunrise & sunset were amazing so tranquil
beach was just next to our hotel  " the surf". it was clean and beautiful. one can spend hours and hours at the beach.

Bentota beach was beautiful! It doesn't feel like other beaches atleast where we were there weren't any sun beds or anything like that it was really under used. We mainly went down to the beach to walk along or to see the sun set but didn't sit here during the day we preferred sitting around the pool area instead as this is what most people were doing so felt odd sitting alone on the beach. It's very clean and beautiful views though so would recommend it!
Nice and clean - endlessly the tide comes in - so swimming and surfing is a delight - some local hawking, but its discreet.
If you want you feel like pirate in a almost empty paradise beach just visit that place. Be careful from the waves of ocean & stay many hours to in joy the magic of that beach.
This beach is stunning and well maintained!  It escapes the pollution that so many Of Sri Lankas beaches have. Also tends to be quiet, making it a perfect spot to relax

The beach is really wide and long so you don't feel crowded. One of the best beaches in Sri Lanka. And the sea is not that rough comparing to hikka beach which is also small and crowded. Since it was not that rough you can swim at the time of my visit

Bentota beach itself is nice, wide and pretty much desert but the surrounding are not so nice, people following you in the street, prices higher than anywhere else including Galle, not the most authentical experience in Sri Lanka where most people are very kind and devoted wherever you go.
The Bentota Beach is great. The sea is clean. and not too crowded in the early evening. It does got a bit crowded in the late evenings but still manageable .

This beach is long, very long, miles and miles long. Golden sand and blue waters throughout the beach. Owing the length of the beach it gets quite desolate in certain sections. We stayed at a property adjoining the beach so security was not really a concern. If you plan on buying Souvenirs on your visit to Sri Lanka, this might be the cheapest and the best place to get them.

This idyllic beach is literally kilometers of golden sun drenched sand with very few people. Most of the water sports take place at the nearby lagoon leaving the beach free for those who simply want to swim and enjoy the sun.

Bentota beach stretches for miles and miles! There's only a few hotels that lead onto the beach so it can get fairly quiet. We walked down the beach for a while. It started out deserted and as we got towards the hotel, a few more people started to appear. There's plenty of room for soaking up the sun and the sea didn't look too rough. However, we sat on the beach nearer the town and found that there were a lot of locals in this area. This wasn't a problem, however a few of the people I was with had bikinis on and we found a lot of men staring at us and even the women were laughing. A bit uncomfortable but I suppose that's what you get in a place with different values and beliefs. I'd recommend heading up to a quieter area of the beach or even near the hotels to avoid this.
