If you are in bentota you must visit . its wonderful.....lot's of space with few people. And lot's of water sport available .....................

Great beach to relax on there are water sports available and if you go later around 5-6pm you can see sunset great to seat on the rocks and watch the sun set great pics nice sand to walk the beach and enjoy the sea views
Smoth sand, clean, not so tough waves, good service. We stayed at Wunderbar and had sunbeds on the beach.

Great Beach..wonderful hotels and most amazingly this is the only place in the Island you get helicopter joy rides. Skylark Helicopters conducting heli joy rides as low as US$50/-. Great place to stay and visit.
This beach is fantastic as there's only a handful of hotels that are on it.  The water is clear and it's not crowded with beach huts etc and therefore feels like a beach in the middle of nowhere.
This beach is pretty nice and was not overcrowded and has some nice eateries nearby. There is also a railway track running close by.
Beautiful beach stretching for miles with soft sand and warm sea water. Need to take an umbrella if going for the day as sun too hot to bear for too long.

Stayed at the Cinnamon Benton Beach Hotel located on Bentota Beach.  Beach was very clean with no debris or algae.  Water was warm and you can walk for at least a mile or two of uninterrupted sandy beach. Beach was wide and almost deserted - very calming and relaxing.
Great beach, lots of space with rather few people. Clean and wide. However be aware of rip currents - not recommendable if you are not a strong swimmer unless you stay in shallow water.
Lovely beach with enjoyably lively surf.  Slightly marred by large numbers of visitors near the big hotels.

Its a very good beach no doubt but gets crowded at peak times like sunset etc. If you are looking for a quite relaxing time in the sun and sand then I will suggest the beaches at Induruwa which is a small tuk-tuk ride away.
Such nice beach. Very calm sea, we could walk almost 1 km inside, lot of water sports activity available.
A great stretch of beach with only a few places to eat its not full of beach shacks which is great and not many beach sellers.
Perfect place to enjoy very clean but some area has rocks so just identify and stay away from it. Near by you can find many hotel but we have chosen Bentota Beach Hotel and it was awesome.
Its a clean and very beautiful beach in Sri Lanka. Could be reached easily via local train from Colombo. Takes around an hour from Colombo. Mostly foreigners are there on this beach.

It is one of the best beaches have been. It is also very clean. There is A temple near the beach. It is a very best place to travel with friends. Best visited during early morning time or evening time.

Fantastic extra long beach with soft, clean sand. Surf is crystal clear and one can swim freely enjoying good waves. Superb for body boarding/surfing. Certainly not over crowded. Polite good sellers - we bought tasty boiled corn with chili powder for a mere Rs100 each. Never saw any umbrella or lounger rentals. Bentota town has loads of touristy shops and great restaurants. The beach is a close second to Mirissa Beach. Worth the visit :)
No seaweed, no rocks, no litter. Just soft sand and crystal clear water. Any Sri Lankan people you come across will greet you with a friendly smile.

Great location and very tranquil. The sand is gold, warm and great to take a snooze on. No one pesters you once asked to leavel
nice long beach with fine sand, great for walking or plaing with kids. during our stay sea was quite calm , so it was good even for small kids to play in water.

The beach is decent and swimmers can enjoy the sea. However, there are barely any facilities for tourist. There are no reasonable restaurants on the beach. There are a few luxury hotels but unless you are staying there, the beach has little to offer in terms  of restaurants.
One of the best hotels in Benton. Excellent food. The pool is not so child friendly due to the rocks at the bottom the pool. Re furbishing was going on last time I visited.
Absolutely clean beach, with awesome views of the sea...... Enjoy the beach with meditation early morning.
Nice place to see,for relax,some places full of people and some empty.water was warm and sand is great.waves but not so big problem to swim
Traveled from Columbo to bentota so glad we did the beach was beautiful very clean no hassle of locals to like you get in goa will definitely be returning again to Sri Lanka 😀

Very beautiful and clean is the first thing that comes to me mind. It's ideal for people who want to just relax, read a book, sun bathe, play or opt water water sports. great food options. The water is clean and the waves are gentle. A must visit place.

This is very clean beach excellent for a morning stroll or evening walk. The beach is very clean & walk on bare foot is a pleasure as sand is very fine. There are excellent facilities for ballooning. However few shades are required for resting after bathing.
Very good private beaches, turtle farm, river safari and water sports in the river. Good sea food, quite place with all facilities
pristine clean, gentle slope, safe water. Not too high and not ever gentle either this time of the year. however, no life guards, so better keep an eye on the little ones.
A beautiful, clean and  natural beach which is great for long walks.  Somewhat spoilt by horribly noisy microlight type aircraft doing trips up and down the beach sometime only feet above your head.

This is a beach to dream of, particularly if you like miles of unspoilt sand and easy access from local hotels - if you are staying close by. The beach is clean and unspoilt. A particular high spot was being able to have a helicopter land on the beach to take us all to Sigiriya

Bentota beach is beautiful. Unspoilt by resorts because you can barely see them from the beach. The beach is wide and before the hotels there are many plants that obscure the view onto the resorts, great! Very different atmosphere than the more southern touristy beaches.

Beautiful white sandy beach. You can arrange lots of activities here, surfing, river safari, turtle sanctuary etc. We went on river safari and bartered down to 3000 rupees for a 2 hour trip and tuk tuk transportation to the river (about a 10 minute ride away). Saw baby crocodiles and lizards and water monitors. Beautiful sunsets over this beach, best viewed from the top of The Loft bar which is on the beach.
The beach at Bentota beach by cinnamon was a clean and a nice place. The sunset view is great and a not to miss

Broad beach, for a considerable distance the waters are shallow and hot. This area is ideal for families with kids. However there is a steep slope beginning suddenly after that, which can be identified where the huge tides are formed suddenly and then broken down when they hit the shallow waters. I personally recommend NEVER to go beyond this point with kids or ones who cannot swim. Went to have a swim from 4:30 to 6:30 couple of times with 4, 6 and two 11 year olds. We strictly kept ourselves in the shallow waters. Nice sunset sceneries for nature photographers. When it gets dark, the sea starts to get rough a bit. Better to leave the sea at this point. Had to go to the hotel to have a bath to clean up the sand. :)
Disappointed with the beach.  Full of broken coral and debris. Better beaches in Zanzibar and Mozambique
The beach is really nice :-) The ocean is clean and very hot :-) It s great that there can find all members of family fun.

The beach is big, clean and beautiful with good waves. There are a few restaurants on the beach but not a lot was open mid December. Be aware that everyone is out to earn more money from you however possible by charging more for tuktuks, commission for drivers and day trips etc.
This is a must see. In truth, I found it hard to do anything else in Bentota. The water is warm, the sand is fine, the jungle backdrop verdant!

Although backed by numerous quality orientated hotels this beach is rarely busy and is very clean. It is possible to walk for hours to the south to a rocky headland topped by the Saman Villas. There are numerous eateries and small bars in the trees behind the sands as well as massage centres, boutique style accommodation options. The sea can be choppy at times and care should be taken when swimming as the current can be unpredictable.
The Beach is clean with clear water.. Its a calm beach where you can just lie down and relax.. You can reach there by tuktuk easily.. There good luxury resorts close to the beach,

Lovely beach, clean, quiet. Nice for relaxing or going for a walk. Lots of small hotels/b and b's along the beach. The sea was quite rough (December time) so have to be careful with kids. But totally gorgeous!
Great place to do watersports, amazing waves, almost no people. Beach is wide and very long, lot of spots to have a nap in the shadow of pineapple trees.

Super neat and clean beach with blue water. The whole stretch from Aluthagama to Bentota and Induruwa offers breathtaking views of the Indian Ocean. We arrived in the evening, and on the suggestion of Our Tuk Tuk driver Dinusha Irosh (+94-77-5539579) we went to the area close to Amal Villa. The next day while on tour and on the way back from Turtle hatchery, we stopped at Induruwa beach. It is worth every penny if you are a beach lover. Such a peaceful tropical delight, free of commercialisation and crowd.

Bentota is first off NOT a party beach.  It's quiet, peaceful, there are some cafes and restaurants, locals selling coconuts... but its quiet.  No one hassles you here to buy anything.  And the beach is long... almost 4km.  I love to walk along the beach, and I walking this for a full two hours each day.  The water is clean, there is NO litter or garbage on the beach, and the sand is nice and soft!  The best part was that its a lovely beach, without it being overcrowded with tourists.

The ocean is like a bath, and it stays very shallow for a good 30 meters from the shore. The sand if soft and clean, and it's one of the best beaches I've seen in Sri Lanka. However, a few other people staying at our hotel (Avani resort and spa) mentioned that they've been told to be careful and watch their valuables on the beach.
cool, breezy, quiet and clean. Not many people on the beach so very good for couples looking for quality time. very clean sand. loved it

Very clean and beautiful beach. You can just walk along the beach for hours without any disturbance - other than the Sea waves!! A golden Sand that is not sticky at all - is another positive to take a dip in the sea.
Bentota beach is a kid friendly beach. You have miles of prestine, clear sandy beach. Hawkers are minimal but you have stores to buy essentials.
Amazing place we where visiting our holiday. The people are very nice and we are vising most places in Bentota.. Come again.
long, wavy unspoiled beachfront. Lovely warm ocean, clean sand and lovely to walk in either direction. Used it every day in preference to our beautiful pool.

One of the cleanest and most attractive beaches of Lanka. The golden sand and clear sea water makes it memorable. I would rate it to be one of finest beaches I visited so far... Taking a beach walk on an early morning is breathtaking...

Walk for miles.  Wildlife to see and Sri Lankan life to experience, especially when the families come out on a Sunday evening.  Really beautiful near to the Vivanta by Taj resort.  White sand backed by jungle and rocks to clamber over and explore.  Simply stunning.
Not many people use the beach for sunbathing so choose your spot or go for strolls in either direction, you won't be disappointed.
Beautiful quiet clean beach which is perfect for sunbathing and swimming. The waves can be a little challenging but this adds to the fun. Stunning sunsets.
Very clean, very quiet, you will hardly meet any tourists there. Plenty of good bars and restaurants
nice beach very clean and not crowded lovely walks as the Indian ocean laps over your feet one of the best beaches
Sri Lanka has some of the best beaches in the world.  On the Indian Ocean side they are so clean and go for miles.  Wonderful  way to start your day by going for a walk.

Been to many beaches and this is one of my favourites. Big expanse of clean sand, fantastic waves, lovely and green. Guys selling stuff here and there but not intrusive.  Lots of cafés behind the tree line. Only downside is that there are no sun loungers but I guess that's why it is still so quiet!!

For me this was by far the best beach in Sri Lanka. It was clean and very quiet which I like very much. It's quite long so it's perfect for long walks. Here and there you'll find places where you can have a drink or meal. It's the perfect beach to relax.

I went to this beach in the evening expecting to see a lot of activity.  What I saw was a few people walking across the beach.  The sea was fairly choppy which is why, perhaps people hadn't ventured out to swim. After walking around a bit I was looking for a place to unwind over a drink with a view of the sea but couldn't find any. I couldn't see any water sport activity at the beach although I did see a place that offered water sport facilities. Nothing to talk about.  Just some sand and water. It could have been a lot better.
you can walk more than 1Km along the beach and on November sea was little bit rough and waves. there is not more restaurant on the beach and only 5 star and 4 star hotel near the beach.

Nice beach to walk along... we watched kids play cricket on the beach for a while! If you want somewhere a bit more secluded then we stayed at the Sea Rock Villa, which had pretty much it's own beach and was a really relaxing place

Bentota beach was always quiet for the full 7 days we were in Sri Lanka and allows for long walks along the coastline. The sea can be a little rough at times, but is fine to take a dip. And there are opportunities to take surf lessons if you so wish

Had a great time on Bentota beach - nice and chilled. Might have been extra quiet because we were staying there out of season... A few people selling things on the beach but not many and definitely easy to relax there and the water was lovely and warm.
We spent six days here and never ventured into the water above our thighs. Actually, it seemed that no one did. But the beach is beautiful to walk on and you will not be bothered.

Nice soft sand beach with clear blue water. No garbage to be seen on the beach. Also not many beach sellers bothering you. Totally not crowded. Current was quite strong however, so maybe not suitable for small children at some places to enter the water.
This is one of the best beaches in Sri Lanka. Perfect for surfing, swimming or simply sunbathing. The waters of the Indian Ocean merge with the Arabian Sea and myriad rivers
Visited the beach for one day, the sea was little bit rough, we stayed in one bar which we can use their beach chair for the whole day , nice beach and what a relaxed day
Bentota has a very comfortable beach with quite warm and very clean water. The beach is long and not crowded so it's very good for playing, relaxing and walking.
Very nice beach to enjoy and on December nice climate to relax on the beach area nice environment 0094716884990 there a driver who can bring every where with smile and safely
I loved it! very clean, the sand is super-soft, found myself many times walking around and couldnt see a person in the next 500m.
Although its mentioned about jelly fish, but its a lovely beach, very clean. Its a good place to walk as well.

It's a beautiful beach. Kids really liked it and were hooked for hours. Can go for a long walk on the beach. at one end , there's this mangroves enclave , it's nice n cool . Can collect lots of shells too.

One of the finest beach, if you visit during this period. The beach is simply beautiful, lot of activities to be done if you are water sports lover, if not then surely finest place to relax and enjoy the beauty of nature. And you can take bath too.
Had been to few beaches around the world. Found Bentota beach one of best after Coxsbazar beach. Golden sand with serene atmosphere! We loved every bit of the nature.

This is the perfect beach to me. Smooth sand with absolutely no rocks, pebbles, seashelles or anything that could hurt your feet. Funny waves to surf on. Not crowed whatsoever. The sand higher up was perfect for walking or running. Clean and beautiful. No disturbing watersport activities. What else could you posibly need?
Wonderful and unspoiled but beware strong and dangerous currents so not for swimming all year round. Would not advise children to go in the water at all.
A really nice long beach for kids to play, clean, safe and during the off monsoon season, the sea was calm, a great place to swim too.
Its a beautiful and very clean beach. The water is also very clean. You can pass unlimited time on the bentota beach
Beautiful sandy beach with nice rock pool for photo opportunity. Try and catch Jimi at the beach entrance to vivanta by taj hotel and book him for your travels around the island.
This is a lovely coast line but maybe because we went to the beach when it was quiet we got severely hassled for guides etc. I have been hassled on resort beaches before but this was very bad.
the beach is very clean. it is only 2 hours drive from colombo and the road to get there is very good. the water of the indian ocean is very clean and we had a great time at the beach.

The surf is too rough to swim in. Beach is pretty clean however and the sand is nice on your feet. Worth going for a long beach walk. A few dodgy characters loitering around but generally they'll leave you alone. They only trying to drum some business selling crap & stuff. Just say no thanks and keep walking...
One if the few clean beaches we have been to Spent two evenings and enjoyed the sea. No smell no dirt just great Worth all the time in the world
Soft, white sandy, uncrowded beach.  Warm clean water.  Great for long walks. Head towards light house and there is also Buddhist temple to visit.

This beach is great. It is very clean and the water is quite warm. At this time of the year the current is too strong to swim but it is good for a little paddle. The beach is quite quiet throughout the week but gets a little busier on the weekends when the locals are out with their families.
From Sigiriya to the Rainforests, down to Galle we covered a lot of the South/West.
Although we were approached by a chap selling sapphires - yes, I did buy - the beach is beautiful. Ideal for a stroll anytime, day or early evening,
Spectacular beach, any time of the day, amazing sunsets, relaxing morning walks. Very safe.  Don ´t miss the Buddha Temple and it´s magic atmosphere.
Bentota beach is very relaxing end enjoyable. Used to visit there all the time. it doesnt matter day or night Bentota is perfect.

Too "surfy" to swim but a wonderful peaceful walk in the waves, was approached by a souvenir seller and a man selling trips to the turtle sanctuary but they walked away after a polite smile and "no thank you"

One of the finest beaches I have visited. Sunset is a sight worth witnessing. Do not  check into The Surf Hotel, Bentota which is a wonderful hotel with a wonderful location. facilities and view but is thoroughly mismanaged as the staff are casul and not courteous.
This beach is a wonderful glamorous, you can enjoy your time there and this beach mostly not crowded which gives u privacy.
Nice clean beach but rough avrg 6 month of the year from JULY TO DEC, so you don't enjoy more but you can walk, swim in nearby area.

White sand, big ocean waves. Sun. I think bentota beach is the most beautiful beach in Sri Lanka. Must see. But be careful: there are a lot of beach boys and they want your money (but they can be very friendly and they speak good English... so you can ask them about anything and they will help you).
A beach with fantastic sand and water. Good hotels and restaurants. very easygoing and tranquil. long stretches for walking.

Just walked and took photographs on the beach both in the mornings and evenings.  My mother on a wheel chair enjoyed the experience of sitting on the beach and enjoying the activities around. calm, serene and very beautiful.  Highly recommended.
Love this beach, so so beautiful. Very clean and not too busy at the time of year we went to so was a real nice relaxing place to be.

Hikkaduwa is a hip hangout with great surfing and partying. Benton is quieter with fine restaurants and hotels. Bentota is reached easily by train and we recommend taking the 6:55 first class train from Colombo that get in to Bentota about 8:30. The beaches down south are the best beaches in the country for its sandy nature. Bentota beach is one main beaches down south and visited by many tourists and locals.
bentota beach was amazing.long white sandy beaches, nice places to stay and eat, locals very friendly. we enjoyed everyday of our visit!
Visit this place if you love clean,calm,beach,river sports.Also good to relax.Beach is very safe.enjoy during day time or evening and may be early night.
Coming to Bentota is like being a castaway on a private island, but there's also a bar....
A must try activity is bentota beach , wide sandy beaches are great for long walks and offerying plenty of luxury hotels and resorts on the beach such as taj , tanjeri e , bentota beach hotel etc.

Bentota and Induruwa beaches are unforgettable. Nice golden sand, beautiful ocean and very calm surroundings are really enjoyable. The waves allows to have surfing. That was our second visit here, and we would like to go there again.
You Can't swim in it and it is not good for snorkeling as you cannot see anything under water due to the sandy water.
Plenty of hotels which you can stop by for a drink or to use their pool and sunloungers, can hire boogie boards and surf boards, no harassment from locals trying to sell things.
A great beach with a lot of nice breaks for the surfing group but never saw anyone on a board.

Vast, wild and rugged, Bentota beach stretches as far as the eye can see in both directions. All along you will come across small hotels dotted in between the larger tourist hotels. There is even a small turtle hospital that looks after injured turtles. The main train line goes along the back of the beach and you can cross the track to get to the smaller family run restaurants. The sea is really rough with huge waves crashing into the shore; definitely not for swimming in! You can hire surf boards on the beach outside the Vivanta where the sea seems to be a little calmer. A great beach for walking on.
We stayed in Sea Rock Villa hotel at Bentota Beach. Bentota was a beautiful, quiet beach. Ideal for swimming and walking and watching the sun set.
Good sunset view. Choppy sea. I saw people availing helicopter rides. Lots of places in Bentota offer this even the hotel can help. chair and sunshade can be hired but no food outlets on the beach.
Stunning unspoilt beach.  Whilst a few Hawkers, they're really no bother and just add to the experience.

this beach is fantastic in beauty and emptiness: not many around with so much space these days. The waves are strong and sometimes the current too, but with careful watch also children can enjoy . reat time body surfing both young and old.  We have been here many different times of the year and still the southern side is the favourite.. (But for those looking for beach nightlife , this may not be it)

If you are interested in tours, you should look for Putha and Lasantha. They are very trustworthy, always with a smile on their faces. I made the temple tour and a tour to Galle with Putha, really enjoyed it and had lots of fun.
We were there out of main season and the expanses of white-sandy empty beach are just beautiful. Plenty of beach cares if you walk a few kilometres. Nice walk from the turtle hatchery to Bentota.
Clean beach if in front of a hotel. Great for Sunbathing. Quite a long stretch. October it was sunny in the morn and raining in eve.

Very Beautiful Beach, Clean and Long Stretch of Sand to walk. Enjoyed the Sunset there. Not much crowded . Red and Pink Sand... Calm...Must Go if you are in Colombo. It is on the Way to Colombo to Galle.
A very nice neat clean and scenic beach. Also visited the turtles there. One of the best beaches in Sri Lanka. Near to Colombo.
Nice clean, secluded beach. Water is clear and rough. Really nice for a stroll across the beach with water touching your feet
The beach was really neat and well maintained. If you go through a resort there, like the Surf, then you can have a room and enjoy the beach. Water was good to have fun in it.
Beautiful water, body surf the waves, soft white sands, restaurants dotted along the beach, quiet & tranquel. Highly recommended if you want to get away in peace.
Beach is quite good ...Perfect view at morning & evening around 6 Pm....Nearby centara ceysands beach resort

Coming from the land that boasts some of the world's best beaches, I was blown away by Bentota Beach. It stretches for miles, and the strip we were on was to did for. It was so clean - mind you, we had checked out the over-polluted Galle Beach and okayish Hikkaduwa Beach before making it to Bentota so had something to compare with. There's the Bentota Beach Resort and Spa on the beachfront, and will be staying here next time I visit.
A very nice neat clean and scenic beach.we also visited the turtles there.there were so many different kinds of turtles there

Excellent beach. Perfect for long walks. Sea was very choppy but I heard it's very calm during the season (Nov - Apr). Water at this time was very muddy too. Nevertheless loved watching the water swell, making those big waves, pushing it towards the shore endlessly.

If you are visiting Srilanka then your itinerary would surely have Bentota in it. It is one of the beaches which closer to Colombo. You can even plan a day trip there or if you would like to spend more time and explore the place then 1-2 night stays can be made. The beach is beautiful but be sure to carry and apply sunscreen. There are many water sports to do there for which you can visit any resort which hosts them. You can do moto-gliding as well which is fun to see the entire beach from the sky. It is as if you are flying. You may even visit the turtle hatcheries which have cute little turtles which are part of sea conservation project. There are many different varieties of rescued turtles who were injured during tsunami. If you are lucky then you might even see some swimming in the sea. If you love seafood then all restaurants have amazing fresh seafood. Crabs and lobsters are must try. We have never stayed in Bentota but you have plenty good options there.  But if you are staying in Colombo then a single day trip is good enough as it is just 2-3 hours from Colombo.

I visited Sri Lanka courtesy "Trip Isle Sri Lanka", a travel agency which gives great experiences at very reasonable rates. At Bentota, the agency arranged for our stay at Pandanus Beach Resort and Spa (5 star) (which is literally a step away from the sea), along with water sports like Jet skiing, river cruise, banana boating etc, all for USD 13 (per head), at Bentota beach. The early morning views are amazing, the surrounding environment astoundingly clean and unadulterated, the sea has strong currents (not recommended for swimming), but its the best place for water sports. I stayed for a day and took back a lifetime of memories; the visit would have been more profound and amazing, if it had been extended to at least 3 days, but there were a lot of time constraints Going without a camera is a big blunder. Love the beach, but be careful in the water. If you bring kids, make sure you keep an eye on them, the waves can be nasty.

Make sure you check on the condition of the water before you enter. Sometimes the currents can be strong and if you are not a good swimmer you could be in some trouble! But the beach is lovely, clean, and you can find vendors selling their wares. I would not recommend leaving anything of value unattended, as there are a lot of people walking the length of the beach.
red flag available for conditions, current quite strong, managed an up to the waist in bath like conditions.
Good Hotel but in need of a bit of TLC all the staff were friendly the only thing they seem to be missing was a tip box for all.
The beach is nice, clean and peaceful. One can go for long stroll. loved taking a stroll. Also people sell great coconut water at a reasonable price

Gorgeous beach with soft golden sand and really warm water. Waves were quite high whilst we were there, however they do operate a flag system warning people of waves. There are no lifeguards on duty. There are a few local guys trying to sell sarongs etc, but they don't pester you too much
Very clean, sandy beaches, accessible and not bothered by local trades people. You could walk for miles.
Great beach....many good hotels nearby.....water sports....walk in the town.....great place to take a break on your way from COLOMBO to galle or beyond!
Very clean, people are very friendly amazing food, the hotel Centara excellent. Overall family were happy.
Its a pretty long beach so its never crowded as such. I loved taking a walk on the beach with my wife. Its very clean with couple of surf shops. We tried surfing on the beach and had a great time.
Miles and miles of sand and warm Indian Ocean, it doesnt get any better. There are no bars (except for hotels) nearby so bring what you need.

The beach is wide and long, golden sand and gentle surf during the season and if you pick the right spot on the beach further towards the northern end, you can virtually have the beach to yourself and also avoid the dreaded beach boys and vendors of other beaches.
All there if you are after ,5 star luxury, great food and golden beach. Downside, need to getup early for sunbeds.

The beach is really wide and long - and although it is not private - our wedding planners build both a bar area and a wedding ceremonial space directly on the beach outside or villa. A few people stopped by as we had the ceremony, but there was not problems what so ever.

This beach is quite unspoilt, especially in comparison to some beaches along the south coast. There are 5* hotels situated behind palm trees but otherwise you feel stranded - such a nice feeling if you've been in some of the more bustling towns around Sri Lanka. Head here for sun set and if you head to the north section of the beach there is a peaceful temple nested up the hill.
Most of beach covered in Litter except where Club Villa and Paradise road. Not a swimming beach strong rips offshore no Surf Beach life savers. Beware. Nice pink sand.
Lovely clean sweep of sand. Pretty fringe of coconut palms.  Swimming not recommend due to rip tides a shame.

The sea was calm and quiet.one could go deep in the sea and yet the water would be waist high only.The water sports are not on the beach but nearby lagoon so u don't get the thrill of the rides as compared to beach
Clean Beach with minimal crowd and very very clean sea. Just love the fact that they save the environment so well.
Honestly i didn't expect Bentota to be better and cleaner than Thailand, but it turned out to be simply superb! You must go to Bentota beach and explore Colombo, and Kandy!
Very awesome place to see, it's not like other asian beaches but the best in srilanka. Prices are very high, and you have to be very careful of beach boys, long hair and dangerous.

It might be because I've traveled and visited many beach around the world but Bentota beach is nothing special to be honest. The surroundings are nice and the beach is quite wild but don't expect a Philippines / Thailand / Mediterrean beach. In any case, it's quite relaxing to take a walk along it
set and relaxed, used jacuzzi, beach, good restaurants good food and live bollywood dance and music was good too.
We loved every aspect of our visit to Bentata and our stay at Vivanta by Taj. We had an excellent room, good food and had a very relaxing time
Golden sand, emerald green water, sapphire blue sky, and ruby red sunset. You need something more in shade of palm trees?
The beech is very clean and lovely sandy surrounded with lush greenery. Water is very clean and shallow.

Quite a good beach, some activities around - and a good spot to surf too. However if you are looking for parties / more activities - better go to Unawatuna / Hakkaduwa. And if you are after the romance - beaches around Tangalle are definitely more atmospheric and tranquil.
Bentota beach has white sand and warm water without crowds of people. There are also a series of restaurants and bars right along the beach. Amazing sunsets

The beach is perfect for a holiday. It's not crowded, it's very clean and you feel like you're in heaven. The beach-boys are not annoying if you tell them politely that you're not interested in their services. The sand strip is very long and beautiful in every direction. The palms are awesome!
Clean and lovely beach.....not very crowded opposite the centara.....lovely sunset watch ,could be spending the entire morning and evening though it can get very sunny post noon.

The waters are a but rough for swimming but the beach was incredibly clean, the sand wonderfully soft and the walk to the Saman Villas one end, to the Bentota Beach Club the other, was beautiful. There are many shady spots along the beach and when we went, very few people. Much less hectic than Unawtuna and Hikkaduwa.
If you are fan of loooong walks on the beach, this is your place ! We walked approximately 4 km and met maybe 100 people in total (both ways walk 8km)

The sand is lovely and clean and its a nice walk along the shore with beautiful trees/shrubs along its edge on the road side so it makes it more private. Just need to be careful of the currents as they can be strong. The beach is also great as only a stones throw from the hotel so easy to pop across to take a stroll.

I liked everything about this beach. Clean and easy access from the hotel. Good crowd around. One can just enjoy walking in the mornings or anytime during the day. I loved being in and out of the water and getting myself clicked every now and then ;)
Good quality of services and price relation, ideal to rest and enjoy the beach. Not much to see about the turtles, only hatcheries regulary run but not in a natural way as other places.
Must see the turtle hatcheries and visit the snorkelling sites of Hakidua, and the ancient fort city of Galle. Must eat at the Ministry of Crabs.
A long beach with beautiful views, clean sands, and water sports available. Nearby hotels have good facilities for the casual visitor.

I have mixed feelings about Bentota Beach. On the one hand I love the soft sand, flat beach and (virtually) no rubbish. There are no buildings on it - not allowed, apparently - so it's just miles of empty beach. However, there are no cliffs to break up the flatness - the contrast makes it prettier, I think. There are sandflies, and NO bars. I do love a beach shack though, but I realise uncontrolled beach shacks = rubbish. I'm hard to please.. There are lots of resorts and it looks like most guests don't venture very far. There is little in the way of cafes and restaurants on the main road. No vibe whatsoever.
Good beach. But be careful about beach boys cause they everytime try to sell something and it's really boring. And important thing is on the beach you don't find any shop.
A truly beautiful stretch of beach, clean, deep and long. The sea has a vey strong undercurrent which makes swimming difficult but great to paddle....not ideal for young children.

The beach is famous among foreigners for the sun & relaxation. Beach is very cleaned unlike some of the beaches in sri lanka, you can have a long walk on the beach in the evening  when the sun is not that hot
Big waves, lots of fun and you can walk forever. We missed the sunset but maybe one day we'll return.
Beautiful  Beachs  rooms are great at  centara  ceysands hotel is lovely hotel for families ,  big rooms  lovely friendly people
Lovely long, quiet beach.  We were not hassled and whilst the sea is quite rough this only makes it more fun.
Like many beeches in Sri Lanka they are sandy with warm water and relatively empty of people. Several watersports including surfing available.

It is very difficult to impress Australians with beaches, but this was a lovely beach. Water sports, lots of sand, ocean was gentle when we were there, great water temperature. Past the south point it is much more secluded, north of the point us where the larger hotels are.
Its a clean beach...eat at amal resturant or order a beer. u will get tables & chair arranged for free at the beach.
Lovely stretch of beautiful sand very quiet. Strong currents be careful when swimming. Natural unspoilt beach.

This public beach is easily accessible by road or by train. Generally crowded, but you can still enjoy. Shower facilities available, which is necessary after a swim in the sea. Their is a restaurant called the loft, if you want to have a bite. 'The Surf ' which is a hotel just by the beach, looks amazing. All the rooms are facing the sea. I am sure they have a spectacular view.
Endless walking beach without bothering of sellers, the beach is clean and like in a movie can beat the Carribean, like Varadaro on Cuba.
Beach is very beautiful and sunset is mesmerising. Walking / jogging in morning is too good. Perfect for swimming as well.
I liked the ocean. To dive on it. to catch the wave!!! it was adrenaline!!! The water was warm. and it was surprize for us.
Lovely clean beach. My wife and I love an afternoon stroll along the beach as the sun is setting. It is a lovely location and nobody bothers you.
We had a kind of private beach in front of the hotel, super! We were not so lucky regarding the weather but that was nobody's fault.

sand and ocean are great, but the beach itself was not clean, a lot of rabbish was everyewhere. all the day street vendors are there, offering small souvenirs , fruits, textiles. prices are quite affordable, but if you go to the city shops you will find even less prices.

Fantastic beach with public and hotel access, I ran the top end near the public access every day for a week, loved it wide, clean sand, warm water and friendly not too many touts. There is some litter around the station and public beach entrance but walk 50 meters north or south and its very clean. The beach is split in two sections the North end towards the stations is about 2 kM long and has lots of big hotels where you can eat or by a day use ticket to. The Southend goes on for ever I never go even near the end I stopped The Wunderba Hotel. There is an Australian style patrolled area by the public beach and this is important if you are not a strong swimmer, there is a sand bar just off shore and some of the currents are deadly strong even for a strong swimmer, they are very much like Australian beaches in this regard. Our family group was aged 18 months to 78 with a swag of kids, everyone got knocked over by a wave or the under tow and the waves are dumpers, it was hard for the littles and the oldies to get up so be safe and have fun.
One of the most beautiful beaches I ever saw. Very few restaurants, hours of walking plesure. Like a postcard!!!
Long empty beach with trees at the edge to hide the hotels. Safe. The water was clean and waves gentle.

Stunning beach in a fabulous natural environment,  long and sandy you can walk for miles.  Lots of little shaded inlets to sun bathe in, restaurants and bars every so often with beds that you can use free usually as long as you buy drinks lunch there etc. Rip tides here in January are very strong and take you by surprise therefore as other reviews have previously mentioned take care when swimming or even just paddling! A fantastic uncrowded beach a must visit in bentota.

Beautiful beach - incredibly clean, but just be mindful of the rip tides.  We went in December and once you get to waist level you find yourself pulled metres down the beach with little choice in the matter.   We were staying at Casa Siena (very good - separate review coming) and from there we could walk over the small railway track, through some greenery, dotted with beautiful docile cattle, direct to the beach.  The walk South takes you almost to Saman Villas, while the walk to the North is much longer and ultimately takes you to a small island with a temple and meditation centre.  We weren't appropriately dressed to visit so a boat from the other side came and picked us up and we continued our walk from there. It can be incredibly windy when the weather isn't at its best - we felt pretty much sand-blasted. There are plenty of places you can cut back through the greenery to eat at. The walk to the South has two of the only true "beach bars" we found (in that they are physically on the beach as opposed to near the railway line). We had shoddy weather pre Christmas, but as it got better some of the tour guides were whizzing by on jet skis and there was also paragliding.  You can book from several guides near the main railway bridge - or ask for Dagi at Wunderbar Hotel (separate review to come) - he's great at organising things to do. There are lots of dogs in Bentota - but they are incredibly chilled out and aren't really interested in you at all, despite me as a beach lover trying to make them come over! There are also a few beach sellers, nothing major - offering shells, sarongs etc.  They aren't pushy at all and we did in fact buy a couple of sarongs for 500 rupees each.

I have given Bentota only 4 stars for one reason . Please be careful with young children and if you are not a strong swimmer ! The beach is spotless and has several beach bars around offering sundbeds food drinks etc . Had another great day there but did find the under current of the sea quite strong and as there are no warning signs up would like people to be aware of what could be a hidden danger in a beautiful natural environment . I stress its my observation and its a must place to visit .
We really couldn't finish walking the entire beach: it simply doesn't end! The waves are a bit strong for swimming, but the winds make it perfect for lounging on the beach.

Clean and litter free that comes to mind with each hotel having its private beach so there is no ogling by those bystanders.  Ideal for swimming and taking long walks.   Even in January the sun is strong after past 9 am.
Bentota beach is a Fantastic long clean and nice beach to visit.. clean and fantastic golden sands. No doubt I will plan to visit this beach again.

the beach is a long stretch of sand fringed by palms and a few large hotels..the sea was rough when we were there and impossible to swim. There are very few sun beds and a few shacks would be welcome. Just a few more facilities would be good. Ideal for long walks it is beautiful.

Bentota beach is beautiful. If you are looking for a long stretch of beach to walk along that is clean and quiet, this is the beach for you. May be too quiet for some but I loved it. Ideal for surfers and those who love jumping the waves!

It was clean, peaceful and not very busy. There's a few guides trying to make some money from tourists but a firm & polite "no thank you" does the trick. There's a turtle farm round the corner and some sort of monastery atop the island at the other end.

no comments, beach is decent. beware of the locals, they are very sweet people though. they are just approaching you for their business like tours, water sports. if you prefer to go make sure you dont pay high. Be careful on sundays,around the beach it will be crowded .

Bentota beach is very average......sea too rough to swim in....more for surfing. It's clean....but no sun beds to speak of.....and no shacks .......having just come from Goa I would say South goa is much better. Overall disappointed with the place
Everything from beach to turtle sanctuary, does work out to be an awesome combination. The people are very nice and helpful. Also, try and see the young corals
A fantastic stretch of shallow, golden sand beach that is dotted with hotels and vendors renting out sunbathing equipment, as well as umbrellas and surfboards.

The best thing I liked about this beach is the cleanliness. Very clean water and some water sports also available at few places. Bentota beach river safari is also good for people interested in river safari.

The beach is stunning. Refreshments available along the long stretch of beach. Sea warm. Waves fun. Love the white sand the fact it is very quiet and the sea is warm but a little heavy on the waves although they are much fun.

Bentota beach is one of the best beaches you would go to. Clean, green, less crowded, clear water and sand... It is beautiful. While sunsets are beautiful and one of the better times to be at the beach, early mornings are awesome too.

I enjoyed a couple of afternoons on Bentota Beach while staying nearby.  Undisturbed [a few 'hello, how are you? where are you from? from the local beach boys, but they were not persistent].  No buildings to be seen when you sit on the beach.  Shade provided by the line of trees between beach and beachroad.  All the hotels are beyond this road so the beach is quiet and peaceful.

I loved it it was very beautiful, very romantic and very relaxing not crowded and very quiet the ocean view rooms are marvelous and there are many good hotels there, centara where we stayed was nice and there was Taj, bentota beach hotel, and Saman villas
We went there during monsoon so the water was choppy. But the beach is very clean n has a beautiful long coastline to walk on.
From my childhood l loved this beach. Nothing that l do not like about this beach.... Sea is not so rough most of the time and good for swimming also if you are interested.
clean and perfect, only a few coconuts float by.  , lovely rocky verges to sit on and watch the waves crashing, clear blue water and lots of water sports etc.
Chilled place, great for a cocktail & Shisha in the evening. During the day nice pool & grounds. Good place to do water sports available on the Bentota river

Really enjoy in beach at bentota each side. Also close by several five and four start hotels. But I hate beach boys there staying close to hotel bcs no privacy and always disturbing guest visiting to beach and try to do the business and most of them price very expansive. I love vivanta by taj and Centara close to beach. Really enjoy in evening playing beach volleyball and swimming.

Clean and calm beach, good for family trip, Can spend at least half day's time. Water sport center nearby is a must visit site. Boating in the Mangroves is really very much thrilling. Over all Bentota trip is not to be missed.

This beach is a real paradise. Very clean sand, not overcrowded. The sea is quite rough (they put the red flag), but you can still swim, just stay close to the beach! Beach sellers are very few, just ignore, they will let you in peace. I also saw them offering quite nice original souvenirs, so don't miss it ;). However, there are no facilities like umbrellas etc.to rent, no shops to buy snacks and water (except for guys selling fruits). So its just good if u are staying in the nearby hotel.

Golden, quiet and a great place for the children to learn to surf and bodyboard, build sandcastles or just simply jump over waves. The guys who offer the surfing lessons just by the entrance to the Taj, Vivanta are really good with teaching 8 years olds to surf - my son was doing it by the middle of his first lesson!
The beach off Induruwa Hotel was very clean but the water was rough for the 2 days that we were there and the red flag was always up meaning we couldn't enter the water.
Lovely beach, very clean, and you will meet locals doing yoga and exercising in the mornings There is direct access to this beach from various hotels.

The beach is quite vast with a line of hotels on one side with the ocean on the other side. We were advised not to venture into the ocean as it was quite rough and the a bit rocky at places and dangerous to swim in.
Unable to swim in the sea during Inter Monsoon season (October). Best time to go is November/December or March/April/May

My boyfriend and I returned from two weeks holiday in Sri Lanka and have to admit that we found the country rather expensive for tourists. We've stayed in a private accommodation so had to self-cater and as such ended up having a few meals out. After our first meal out we’ve realised that this is not going to be a cheap trip as the meal for two cost us £25, which I believe is rather high for a 3rd world country. We also experienced how greedy some Sri Lankan people can be including our driver. I've asked him to take us to a jewellery shop in Galle, which I found via Trip Advisor. While we were in another shop he went to the jewellery shop and told them that he is going to bring two Westerners and therefore expects commission if we were to buy something. When we got into the shop the shop owner told us about this and explained that he does not operate his business on commissions. I was shocked about the driver's behaviour. I ended up buying a pair of earrings there and when we were picked up by the driver his English miraculously improved as he was asking as to what I've bought and for how much (in order to determine his commission I suspect). Obviously I didn't tell him what I purchased exactly as agreed with the owner, however that did not stop the driver to go back to the shop, after dropping us off at a restaurant for lunch, and ask for his commission. I found out about this as I had to go back to the shop to re-confirm a few details. I was not happy with this behaviour! Another expensive experience was at the wood carving shops we were taken into by the driver. The prices were unbelievably high. For example for a mask the shop keeper wanted £100, which he then reduced to £80 "with a discount". What a rip-off! Of course we did not buy anything from the shops the driver took us into but rather did our own shopping, which he did not appreciate as he missed out on his commissions. As for the sightseeing, the entrance fees are really high $30 per person, which I don't believe is justified by what you see (Sigiriya and Polonnaruwa). On top of that, paying with credit card is extremely rare in Sri Lanka. Clearly cash is the king in this place as in the majority of the restaurants and at the sightseeing sites we had to pay with cash. My boyfriend and I agreed that we will not be coming back anytime soon. We found our holiday place in Caribbean which is far better in terms of value for money and services.

This is a fantastic and very long beach to walk along, with all kinds of driftwood, seed pods and shells to discover. It's quite a wild sea, with big waves and riptides, so I never actually swam in it, although I might have done in calmer weather.

Bentota is a clean, beautiful and peaceful beach. Its not commercialized i.e you dont see hawkers or shops around. Locals come for a walk sometimes or some come to play cricket.  There isnt no disturabance on the beach and you can have a peaceful time. The sand is soft and non sticky. Beach isnt too deep and ideal for swimming. Right opposite to the beach is the small Bentota railway station.

The beach had clear sand and was not busy at all, very peaceful. It was great to watch the waves, however, it was too strong to swim in and locals told me that most people do not swim in it, at this time of year at least. There are plenty of opportunities for watersports, which I did not do but gather are available from local touts up and down the beach.
Bentota Beaches are wavy and normal. If you want a real beach holiday better choose Maldives! Since sea was too wavy, I couldn't enjoy much during the stay.
Great place to watch the sunset and water activities. The beach is clean but sometimes busy with tourists and "salesmen"
It just isn't that special. I am told the east of Sri Lanka is better. It isn't horrible, just not special.

Aug/Sept the wild sea is calming but still very dangerous - do not attempt to swim!  One local drowned while we were there.  Hawkers prolific and annoying, but no real trouble.  Choose Nov - April for reportedly safe bathing.
There is nothing to dislike about Bentota beach.. It really clean and well managed.. I liked everything.
The beach is very clean.  No rocks or trash to take away from its beauty.  Very relaxing.  The water was nice and warm, you could stay in for hours
beach was immaculate and water blue and warm - (june) the lifeguard and flag warning system rigorous and well managed

From Colombo city center its 64 km s on Galle road between Beruwala and Hikkaduwa. This is one of the most visited tourist destination in Sri Lanka so far. Here you get Hotels and resorts complex, beach , lagoon and the river at once. It s well recommended for Water Sports , Swimming and inland sightseeing.
